name: SpiderFoot
raw_description: SpiderFoot is an open source intelligence (OSINT) automation tool.
description_en: Open-source OSINT automation framework that integrates 200+ data sources to build comprehensive intelligence profiles on domains, IPs, emails, usernames, and organizations. Supports both passive and active collection modes with a web-based interface.
description_zh_tw: SpiderFoot 是一款開源情報（OSINT）自動化工具，整合了幾乎所有可用的資料來源，可自動化地對目標進行全面的情報收集。
use_cases: Passive reconnaissance on a suspicious domain — auto-aggregates DNS, WHOIS, IP reputation
Email address investigation — traces linked social accounts and breach records
Corporate attack-surface mapping — discovers exposed subdomains and services
use_cases_zh_tw: 對可疑網域進行被動偵察 — 自動彙整 DNS、WHOIS、IP 信譽資料
電子郵件地址調查 — 追蹤關聯的社群帳號與資料外洩記錄
企業攻擊面映射 — 發現暴露的子網域與服務

name: Maltego
raw_description: Maltego is an open source intelligence and forensics application.
description_en: Visual link-analysis platform for OSINT and digital forensics. Maps relationships between people, organizations, domains, IPs, and social accounts through an interactive graph interface. Industry-standard tool for complex network investigations.
description_zh_tw: Maltego 是一款開源情報與數位鑑識應用程式，提供視覺化的關聯分析介面，能夠快速挖掘並呈現人員、組織、網域、IP 等實體之間的關係圖譜。
use_cases: Map an organization's infrastructure — discover domain, IP, and ASN relationships
Trace social media account connections to identify associated persons
Visualize threat-actor attack infrastructure in digital forensics investigations
use_cases_zh_tw: 映射組織的基礎設施 — 發現網域、IP 和 ASN 之間的關聯關係
追蹤社群媒體帳號連結以識別關聯人員
在數位鑑識調查中視覺化威脅來源的攻擊基礎設施

name: Shodan
raw_description: Shodan is the world's first search engine for Internet-connected devices.
description_en: Internet-of-things search engine that continuously scans and indexes all internet-connected devices — servers, cameras, industrial control systems, routers — with full service banners and vulnerability data. Essential for exposure assessment and infrastructure intelligence.
description_zh_tw: Shodan 是全球首個針對連網裝置的搜尋引擎，可搜尋暴露在網路上的伺服器、攝影機、工業控制系統、路由器等裝置，是網路情報分析與攻擊面評估的核心工具。
use_cases: Find all internet-exposed services for a target organization to assess attack surface
Search for publicly exposed industrial systems or misconfigured cameras
Track global exposure of a specific CVE vulnerability across hosting providers
ethics_note: Use only against systems you are authorized to assess. Shodan indexes real production systems; unauthorized enumeration or access may violate computer fraud statutes.
use_cases_zh_tw: 尋找目標組織所有暴露於網際網路的服務以評估攻擊面
搜尋公開暴露的工業控制系統或配置錯誤的監視器
追蹤特定 CVE 漏洞在各雲端託管商的全球暴露情況

name: WhatsMyName
raw_description: This tool allows to enumerate usernames across many websites.
description_en: Web-based username enumeration tool that checks a given handle against hundreds of platforms simultaneously. Returns a verified list of active accounts with direct links, making it faster than manual searches for building a cross-platform presence map.
description_zh_tw: WhatsMyName 允許使用者在數百個網站上批量查詢特定用戶名是否存在，快速建立目標的數位足跡地圖。
use_cases: Check a username across hundreds of platforms in one query
Build a starting list of confirmed social accounts for a person of interest
Detect impersonation accounts using a known handle on unexpected platforms
use_cases_zh_tw: 在一次查詢中檢查特定使用者名稱在數百個平台上的存在情況
為特定調查對象建立已確認社群帳號的初始清單
偵測在未預期平台上使用已知帳號名稱的冒牌帳號

name: theHarvester
raw_description: E-mails, subdomains and names Harvester. OSINT tool.
description_en: Command-line OSINT tool that harvests email addresses, subdomains, hosts, and employee names from public sources including Google, Bing, LinkedIn, and Shodan. Widely used in the reconnaissance phase of security assessments.
description_zh_tw: theHarvester 是一款命令列 OSINT 工具，可從多種公開資料來源自動收集電子郵件地址、子網域與員工姓名，常用於滲透測試的前期偵查階段。
use_cases: Automatically collect employee email addresses from public data before a security assessment
Enumerate all discoverable subdomains and hosts for a target domain
Aggregate multiple open-source intelligence feeds to build an initial target profile
use_cases_zh_tw: 在安全評估前從公開數據中自動收集員工電子郵件地址
列舉目標網域的所有可探測子網域和主機
彙整多個開源情報源以建立初始目標檔案

name: IntelligenceX
raw_description: Search engine for leaked data, dark web content, and historical snapshots.
description_en: Deep search engine indexing leaked datasets, dark web content, Tor sites, Telegram channels, and archived snapshots. Useful for tracing breach exposure, finding deleted content, and researching threat actors. Free tier provides limited results.
description_zh_tw: IntelligenceX 是一個付費搜尋引擎，可查詢資料洩露檔案、暗網內容、Tor 網站及歷史快照，是調查資料洩露事件與暗網活動的重要資源。
use_cases: Search a target email or username for exposure in known breach datasets
Investigate dark-web forum discussions mentioning a target organization
Retrieve historical snapshots of websites that have since been taken offline
ethics_note: Contains large volumes of leaked personal data. Ensure your investigation mandate is lawful; distributing or acting on scraped personal data may violate privacy regulations.
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋目標電子郵件或使用者名稱在已知資料外洩數據集中的暴露情況
調查暗網論壇中提及目標組織的討論內容
檢索已下線網站的歷史快照

name: Censys
raw_description: Censys is a search engine that allows computer scientists to ask questions about the devices and networks that compose the Internet.
description_en: Internet-wide scanning platform providing continuous data on all internet-exposed hosts, TLS certificates, and websites. Useful for discovering an organization's full exposure footprint through certificate transparency logs and service banners.
description_zh_tw: Censys 是一款專注於網際網路設備與憑證掃描的搜尋引擎，提供對全球主機、網站及憑證的持續性掃描資料，廣泛用於攻擊面管理與資安合規評估。
use_cases: Search all TLS certificates issued for a target organization to discover unlisted subdomains
Analyze service configurations and security posture for a specific ASN or IP range
Monitor an organization's public exposure and identify unauthorized or expired services
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋為目標組織核發的所有 TLS 憑證以發現未列出的子網域
分析特定 ASN 或 IP 範圍的服務配置與安全狀態
監控組織的公開暴露情況，並識別未授權或過期的服務

name: OSINT Framework
raw_description: OSINT framework focused on gathering information from free tools or resources.
description_en: Visual taxonomy of OSINT tools organized by investigation target type. Displays hundreds of free tools in an interactive tree, making it the fastest starting point for identifying which tools to use for a given investigation objective.
description_zh_tw: OSINT Framework 是一個視覺化的 OSINT 工具目錄，以樹狀圖方式整理數百個免費情報工具，按調查目標類型分類，是情報分析師快速尋找合適工具的入門導覽資源。
use_cases: Quickly find available tools for a specific target type — phone, social media, domain
Introduce new analysts to the OSINT tool ecosystem as a reference overview
Plan a tool chain before starting an investigation to ensure complete coverage
use_cases_zh_tw: 快速尋找適用於特定目標類型（電話、社群媒體、網域等）的可用工具
為新進分析師介紹 OSINT 工具生態系統作為參考指引
在開始調查前規劃工具鏈以確保覆蓋完整

name: Chiasmodon
raw_description: Chiasmodon is an OSINT tool designed to assist in the process of gathering information about a target domain.
description_en: Domain-focused OSINT tool that aggregates associated emails, credentials, CIDR ranges, ASNs, subdomains, and even Google Play app IDs linked to a target domain. Useful for deep organizational footprinting beyond standard DNS enumeration.
description_zh_tw: Chiasmodon 是一款針對網域情報收集的 OSINT 工具，可搜尋網域關聯的電子郵件、憑證、CIDR、ASN 與子網域，適合針對特定組織進行深度網域調查。
use_cases: Collect all email addresses and credential leaks associated with a target domain
Enumerate CIDR ranges and ASNs linked to the organization's network topology
Track mobile apps published by the target organization on Google Play
use_cases_zh_tw: 收集與目標網域關聯的所有電子郵件地址與憑證洩露記錄
列舉與組織網路拓撲連結的 CIDR 範圍與 ASN
追蹤目標組織在 Google Play 上發布的行動應用程式

name: Have I Been Pwned
raw_description: Check if your email has been compromised in a data breach.
description_en: The definitive breach notification service. Enter an email address or phone number to check if it has appeared in any known data breach. Maintained by security researcher Troy Hunt with verified, de-duplicated breach data from hundreds of incidents.
description_zh_tw: Have I Been Pwned 是由資安研究員 Troy Hunt 維護的免費服務，可查詢電子郵件或電話號碼是否出現在已知資料洩露事件中，是個人隱私監控與帳號安全評估的標準工具。
use_cases: Quickly confirm whether a target email appeared in known breach databases
Assess historical account exposure risk during a phishing investigation
Monitor an organization's domain email addresses for breach appearances
use_cases_zh_tw: 快速確認目標電子郵件是否出現在已知的外洩資料庫中
在網路釣魚調查期間評估歷史帳號的暴露風險
監控組織網域內的電子郵件地址是否出現在外洩事件中

name: Recon-ng
raw_description: Open Source Intelligence gathering tool aimed at reducing the time spent harvesting information from open sources.
description_en: Modular OSINT reconnaissance framework with a Metasploit-like interface. Features a marketplace of modules for automated data collection from DNS, social platforms, and search engines. Suitable for analysts who need structured, repeatable collection workflows.
description_zh_tw: Recon-ng 是一款模組化的開源情報收集框架，介面類似 Metasploit，提供豐富的模組可自動化從 DNS、社交媒體、搜尋引擎等來源收集資訊，適合有一定技術背景的滲透測試人員。
use_cases: Automate DNS and network information gathering using a modular workflow
Integrate multiple APIs (Shodan, VirusTotal) for systematic reconnaissance
Export collected intelligence directly into a reporting pipeline
use_cases_zh_tw: 使用模組化工作流程自動收集 DNS 和網路資訊
整合多個 API（Shodan、VirusTotal 等）進行系統化偵察
將收集的情報直接匯出到報告管道中

name: Google Dorks / GHDB
raw_description: Google Hacking Database: a database of Google search queries that expose sensitive information.
description_en: Community database of advanced Google search queries (dorks) that surface misconfigured or exposed resources — login pages, sensitive files, error messages, and open directories. A reference library for passive web intelligence gathering.
description_zh_tw: Google Hacking Database（GHDB）是一個收錄大量 Google 進階搜尋語法（Dork）的資料庫，可用於發現暴露的敏感文件、登入頁面、未授權資料庫等。
use_cases: Locate exposed sensitive configuration files on a target domain using precise search operators
Search for default login pages on specific technology stacks during an authorized assessment
Find accidentally indexed internal documents exposed via search engines
ethics_note: Google Dorking can reveal unauthorized access paths. Use only with explicit authorization, or restrict queries to your own infrastructure.
use_cases_zh_tw: 使用精確的搜尋運算子定位目標網域上暴露的敏感配置檔案
在獲授權的評估期間，搜尋特定技術棧上的預設登入頁面
尋找經搜尋引擎意外索引而暴露的內部文件

name: ExifTool
raw_description: Read, Write and Edit Meta Information in image and other file types.
description_en: Gold-standard metadata extraction tool supporting hundreds of image, video, and document formats. Reads EXIF, IPTC, and XMP metadata including GPS coordinates, device fingerprints, and timestamps. Essential for image verification and document attribution.
description_zh_tw: ExifTool 是功能最完整的元資料讀寫工具，支援數百種圖片、影片與文件格式的 EXIF 等元資料操作，在 OSINT 調查中常用於從圖片中提取 GPS 座標、拍攝裝置及時間戳記等資訊。
use_cases: Extract GPS coordinates from an uploaded image to determine the shoot location
Analyze document metadata to identify author names, software, and modification history
Verify a photograph's claimed origin by cross-checking timestamps and device fingerprints
use_cases_zh_tw: 從上傳的圖片中提取 GPS 座標以確定拍攝位置
分析文件後設資料（Metadata）以識別作者姓名、軟體和修改歷史
透過交叉比對時間戳記和裝置指紋，驗證相片所聲稱的來源

name: Sherlock
raw_description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks.
description_en: CLI tool that searches for a given username across 400+ social networks and platforms. Outputs confirmed account URLs with minimal false positives. The standard starting tool for username-based investigations.
description_zh_tw: Sherlock 是一款熱門的開源工具，可在 400 多個社交網路上搜尋特定用戶名是否存在，命令列介面簡潔高效，是社交媒體帳號調查的標準入門工具。
use_cases: Search a username across hundreds of platforms to confirm account presence
Track a scammer or harasser's cross-platform activity trail
Build a social media account inventory for a missing person or suspect
use_cases_zh_tw: 在數百個平台上搜尋特定使用者名稱以確認帳號是否存在
追蹤詐騙者或騷擾者的跨平台活動軌跡
為失蹤人員或嫌疑人建立社群媒體帳號清單

name: COMB Lookup
raw_description: The largest dataset of leaked credentials.
description_en: Web interface to query the COMB (Combination Of Many Breaches) dataset — one of the largest compiled breach collections. Returns whether an email address appears in the aggregated dataset. Use only to assess your own or authorized accounts.
description_zh_tw: COMB（Combination Of Many Breaches）是目前規模最大的憑證洩露資料集查詢工具，收錄超過 32 億筆電子郵件與密碼組合，可用於確認目標帳號是否存在已知憑證洩露。
use_cases: Check whether an email address appears in large-scale aggregated breach collections
Identify possible credential sources during an account takeover investigation
Assess employee account exposure on corporate domains
ethics_note: Contains real leaked passwords. Use only for lawful security assessment or to verify your own account exposure. Never attempt unauthorized login with found credentials.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查電子郵件地址是否出現在大規模彙整的資料外洩集合中
在帳號被盜調查中，識別可能的憑證洩漏來源
評估企業網域內員工帳號的暴露風險

name: PimEyes
raw_description: PimEyes is an online face search engine.
description_en: Commercial facial recognition reverse-image search engine. Upload a face photo to discover where that person appears elsewhere online. Used in identity verification, missing person cases, and detecting unauthorized use of profile photos.
description_zh_tw: PimEyes 是一款商業人臉辨識搜尋引擎，可透過上傳人臉圖片在網路上搜尋包含相同人臉的其他圖片，廣泛用於尋找失蹤人員、確認人員身分，或調查未授權使用他人照片的情況。
use_cases: Upload a face photo to discover other public images of the same person
Investigate stolen profile photos used by fake social media accounts
Assist in missing person cases by searching for online activity traces
ethics_note: Facial recognition involves sensitive biometric data. Comply with local privacy law (e.g., GDPR). Never use for unauthorized tracking or surveillance of private individuals.
use_cases_zh_tw: 上傳人臉相片以搜尋同一個人在網路上的其他公開影像
調查虛假社群媒體帳號所使用的盜用大頭貼
透過搜尋網路活動軌跡，協助調查失蹤人員案件

name: WiGLE
raw_description: Wireless network mapping and geolocation database.
description_en: Crowdsourced database mapping the physical locations of Wi-Fi access points and mobile base stations globally. Search by SSID or MAC address to retrieve historical geolocation data. Useful for device tracking and wireless security research.
description_zh_tw: WiGLE 是一個收錄全球無線網路位置資料的資料庫，透過眾包方式建立 WiFi 熱點與行動網路基地台的地理位置地圖。
use_cases: Look up the historical geolocations of a specific Wi-Fi SSID or MAC address
Corroborate a subject's historical presence in a location using wireless network records
Analyze Wi-Fi density and network security configurations in a geographic area
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢特定 Wi-Fi SSID 或 MAC 地址的歷史地理位置
使用無線網路記錄佐證調查對象在某處的歷史活動足跡
分析特定地理區域的 Wi-Fi 密度和網路安全配置

name: Lampyre
raw_description: Data analysis & OSINT tool.
description_en: Commercial OSINT data analysis platform with a unified interface for dozens of data sources. Provides graph-based visualization and relationship mapping for people, organizations, phone numbers, and emails — suited for analysts who need an all-in-one paid workstation.
description_zh_tw: Lampyre 是一款商業 OSINT 資料分析工具，提供統一介面整合數十個資料來源，支援視覺化分析與關係圖譜，適合需要在單一平台完成資料收集、可視化與分析的專業調查人員。
use_cases: Integrate multiple sources in one platform for comprehensive background research
Visualize complex relationships between persons, companies, and phone numbers
Conduct multi-dimensional data cross-analysis for financial fraud investigations
use_cases_zh_tw: 在單一平台中整合多個來源以進行全面的背景調查
視覺化人員、公司與電話號碼之間的複雜關係
為金融詐欺調查進行多維度數據交叉分析

name: Tookie-OSINT
raw_description: Advanced OSINT information gathering tool for social media accounts.
description_en: Advanced open-source tool for locating social media accounts based on username, name, or keyword inputs. Offers fuzzy-matching capabilities beyond Sherlock's exact-match approach, useful when a target uses slight variations of their handle across platforms.
description_zh_tw: Tookie-OSINT 是一款進階的社交媒體帳號搜尋工具，具備比 Sherlock 更豐富的模糊搜尋能力，適合針對特定個人進行跨平台帳號關聯分析。
use_cases: Search for accounts using similar usernames with slight variations
Track a target's multi-platform social footprint in counter-fraud investigations
Perform cross-platform account correlation analysis for a specific individual
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋使用相似使用者名稱（微幅變形）的帳號
在反詐欺調查中追蹤目標的跨平台社群足跡
對特定個人進行跨平台帳號關聯分析

name: Maigret
raw_description: Collect a dossier on a person by username only, using data from thousands of sites.
description_en: Username OSINT tool that checks thousands of sites and aggregates additional personal identifiers (real name, location, linked accounts) from profile data where available. Produces richer dossiers than simpler enumeration tools by chaining discovered data.
description_zh_tw: Maigret 可透過用戶名在數千個網站上收集個人資訊檔案，從帳號資料中聚合真實姓名、位置與關聯帳號，產生比 Sherlock 更豐富的調查報告。
use_cases: Build a detailed profile from a single username by chaining discovered identifiers
Automatically generate an HTML investigation report from username search results
Identify a subject's linked accounts when they use the same handle on niche platforms
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過串接已發現的識別碼，從單一使用者名稱建立詳細檔案
從使用者名稱搜尋結果自動生成 HTML 調查報告
當調查對象在小眾平台使用相同帳號名稱時，識別其關聯帳號

name: Holehe
raw_description: Check if an email is attached to an account on over 120 websites.
description_en: Email-to-account enumeration tool that checks whether an email address is registered on 120+ platforms including Twitter, Instagram, and GitHub. Works by testing registration flows without creating accounts, making it an efficient passive email OSINT step.
description_zh_tw: Holehe 可檢查一個電子郵件地址是否在超過 120 個網站（包括 Twitter、Instagram、GitHub 等）上注冊了帳號，透過測試注冊流程而無需建立帳號，是高效的被動電子郵件 OSINT 工具。
use_cases: Check which platforms a target email address is registered on
Link a known email to social media accounts before conducting deeper research
Verify whether an email address belongs to an active online identity
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查目標電子郵件地址在哪些平台上註冊了帳號
在進行更深度的調查前，將已知電子郵件連結至其社群媒體帳號
驗證電子郵件地址是否屬於活躍的網路身分

name: Hunter.io
raw_description: Email finder and verification service.
description_en: Email discovery service that finds professionally used email addresses associated with a domain, discovers the email format pattern used by an organization, and verifies deliverability. Useful for identifying employee contacts in corporate investigations.
description_zh_tw: Hunter.io 是一個電子郵件地址發現與驗證服務，可根據域名查找公開的員工電子郵件地址，識別組織使用的電子郵件格式，並驗證郵件地址的可達性。
use_cases: Find publicly listed email addresses associated with a company domain
Identify an organization's email naming pattern (e.g., first.last@company.com)
Verify whether a discovered email address is deliverable before use in an investigation
use_cases_zh_tw: 尋找與公司網域關聯的公開列出電子郵件地址
識別組織的電子郵件命名規則（例如 first.last@company.com）
在調查使用前，驗證所發現的電子郵件地址是否可送達

name: Phonebook.cz
raw_description: Lists all domains, email addresses, or URLs for a given input domain.
description_en: Free email and domain intelligence lookup that returns all associated email addresses, subdomains, and URLs for a given query. Aggregates from passive sources and breach data, making it fast for enumerating corporate email exposure.
description_zh_tw: Phonebook.cz 是免費的電子郵件與網域情報查詢工具，可返回指定域名的所有關聯電子郵件地址、子網域與 URL，來源包含被動公開資料與洩露資料集。
use_cases: Enumerate all email addresses exposed under a corporate domain
Quickly surface subdomains for a target domain from aggregated passive data
Cross-reference email lists against breach databases for exposure assessment
use_cases_zh_tw: 列舉企業網域下暴露的所有電子郵件地址
從彙整的被動數據中快速呈現目標網域的子網域
將電子郵件清單與外洩資料庫進行交叉比對以進行暴露評估

name: SecurityTrails
raw_description: Historical DNS data, subdomain finder, and domain intelligence API.
description_en: Domain and IP intelligence platform providing historical DNS records, subdomain enumeration, WHOIS history, and associated infrastructure data. Essential for tracing domain ownership changes and discovering previously connected infrastructure.
description_zh_tw: SecurityTrails 提供歷史 DNS 記錄、子網域枚舉、WHOIS 歷史及相關基礎設施資料，是追蹤網域所有權變更與發現過去連接基礎設施的重要工具。
use_cases: Retrieve historical DNS A records to find IP addresses a domain previously resolved to
Discover all subdomains for a target domain from passive DNS data
Trace WHOIS ownership history to identify prior registrants of a suspicious domain
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢索歷史 DNS A 記錄以尋找網域先前解析過的 IP 地址
從被動 DNS 數據中發現目標網域的所有子網域
追蹤 WHOIS 所有權歷史以識別可疑網域的先前註冊人

name: DNSdumpster
raw_description: Free domain research tool for DNS recon and network mapping.
description_en: Free passive DNS research tool that generates visual network maps of a domain's DNS records, subdomains, MX servers, and host relationships. No account required; results are delivered as a diagram and downloadable spreadsheet.
description_zh_tw: DNSdumpster 是一個免費的被動 DNS 研究工具，可生成網域 DNS 記錄、子網域、MX 伺服器和主機關係的視覺化網路地圖，無需帳號，結果以圖表和試算表呈現。
use_cases: Generate a visual DNS map of a target domain's subdomains and mail servers
Identify MX records to understand an organization's email infrastructure
Get a quick passive overview of a domain's network footprint before deeper analysis
use_cases_zh_tw: 生成目標網域的子網域與郵件伺服器的視覺化 DNS 地圖
識別 MX 記錄以瞭解組織的電子郵件基礎設施
在深入分析前，快速獲取網域網路足跡的被動概覽

name: Subfinder
raw_description: Passive subdomain discovery tool.
description_en: Fast passive subdomain discovery tool that aggregates results from certificate transparency logs, DNS records, and 40+ passive data sources. Produces clean, deduplicated subdomain lists without touching the target's servers.
description_zh_tw: Subfinder 是一款快速的被動子網域發現工具，從憑證透明度日誌、DNS 記錄和 40 多個被動資料來源聚合結果，在不接觸目標伺服器的情況下產生乾淨的子網域列表。
use_cases: Enumerate all passive-source subdomains for a target domain before authorized testing
Feed discovered subdomains into further enumeration or vulnerability scanning pipelines
Rapidly map an organization's subdomain landscape using certificate transparency data
use_cases_zh_tw: 在授權測試前，從被動來源列舉目標網域的所有子網域
將發現的子網域傳輸到進一步的列舉或漏洞掃描管道中
利用憑證透明度數據快速映射組織的子網域分佈圖

name: BuiltWith
raw_description: Find out what a website is built with.
description_en: Website technology profiler that identifies the full stack of a web property — CMS, JavaScript frameworks, analytics tools, CDN, email service providers, and more. Useful for understanding a target's technology footprint and identifying potential attack vectors.
description_zh_tw: BuiltWith 可識別網站使用的完整技術棧，包括 CMS、JavaScript 框架、分析工具、CDN 和電子郵件服務提供商，有助於了解目標的技術足跡和識別潛在攻擊向量。
use_cases: Profile a target organization's web technology stack for security assessment
Identify which third-party analytics and marketing tools expose a site's data flows
Discover CMS version information that may indicate unpatched vulnerabilities
use_cases_zh_tw: 剖析目標組織的網站技術棧以進行安全評估
識別哪些第三方分析與行銷工具暴露了網站的數據流
發現可能指出未修補漏洞的 CMS 版本資訊

name: Wayback Machine
raw_description: Internet Archive's Wayback Machine for historical website snapshots.
description_en: Internet Archive's web snapshot service storing billions of archived web pages dating back to 1996. Retrieve deleted pages, track how a website changed over time, and recover content that has been actively removed — all without touching the live target.
description_zh_tw: Wayback Machine 是 Internet Archive 的網頁快照服務，儲存了數十億個自 1996 年以來的網頁歸檔，可用於檢索已刪除頁面、追蹤網站變更，以及在不接觸活躍目標的情況下恢復已刪除內容。
use_cases: Retrieve deleted pages or removed content from a target website
Track changes to a domain's homepage and content over months or years
Recover WHOIS or contact information that was later scrubbed from a site
use_cases_zh_tw: 從目標網站檢索已刪除的頁面或移除的內容
追蹤網域首頁和內容在數月或數年期間的變更
恢復後來從網站上清除的 WHOIS 或聯絡資訊

name: ViewDNS.info
raw_description: Free DNS lookup, reverse IP, and domain research tools.
description_en: Multi-tool DNS and domain investigation platform offering reverse IP lookups, WHOIS queries, DNS record history, IP geolocation, and port scanning. Useful for correlating IPs with hosted domains and tracing domain registration history.
description_zh_tw: ViewDNS.info 是多功能 DNS 和網域調查平台，提供反向 IP 查詢、WHOIS 查詢、DNS 記錄歷史、IP 地理定位和端口掃描，有助於關聯 IP 與託管網域以及追蹤網域注冊歷史。
use_cases: Perform a reverse IP lookup to find all domains hosted on a shared server
Query historical WHOIS records to identify previous domain registrants
Check which DNS records changed around a suspicious domain transfer date
use_cases_zh_tw: 執行反向 IP 查詢以尋找託管在共享伺服器上的所有網域
查詢歷史 WHOIS 記錄以識別先前的網域註冊人
檢查可疑網域移轉日期前後變更的 DNS 記錄

name: IPinfo
raw_description: IP address geolocation and network intelligence API.
description_en: IP address intelligence platform providing ASN, geolocation, ISP, carrier, hosting provider, and abuse contact data for any IP address. Widely used as the first lookup step when investigating an IP address in an incident or intelligence report.
description_zh_tw: IPinfo 提供任意 IP 地址的 ASN、地理位置、ISP、運營商、托管提供商和濫用聯繫資料，是調查事件或情報報告中 IP 地址時的標準首步查詢工具。
use_cases: Identify the ASN, hosting provider, and geolocation of a suspicious IP address
Determine whether an IP is a VPN, datacenter, or residential address
Retrieve abuse contact information for reporting malicious IP activity
use_cases_zh_tw: 識別可疑 IP 地址的 ASN、託管提供商與地理位置
判斷 IP 是 VPN、資料中心還是住宅網路地址
檢索濫用聯絡資訊以舉報惡意 IP 活動

name: GreyNoise
raw_description: Context on internet scanner IP addresses and noise in your security data.
description_en: Threat intelligence platform that classifies internet-wide scanning and noise-generating IP addresses. Identifies whether an IP is a known scanner, benign research tool, or malicious actor — helping analysts separate signal from noise in security investigations.
description_zh_tw: GreyNoise 是威脅情報平台，對全網掃描和生成噪音的 IP 地址進行分類，幫助分析師區分掃描器、良性研究工具和惡意行為者，以便在安全調查中區分信號與噪音。
use_cases: Determine whether a suspicious IP is a known mass scanner before escalating an alert
Filter benign internet-wide scanner traffic from actual targeted intrusion attempts
Enrich IP intelligence reports with community-sourced scanner classification
use_cases_zh_tw: 在呈報警報前，判斷可疑 IP 是否為已知的群發掃描器
從實際針對性的入侵企圖中過濾出無害的網際網路掃描流量
透過社群來源的掃描器分類豐富 IP 情報報告

name: AbuseIPDB
raw_description: Database of abusive IP addresses reported by the community.
description_en: Community-driven IP abuse reporting and lookup service. Returns a confidence score and report history for an IP address based on community submissions. Useful for quickly assessing whether an IP has been flagged for spam, brute force, or scanning activity.
description_zh_tw: AbuseIPDB 是社群驅動的 IP 濫用舉報和查詢服務，根據社群提交返回 IP 地址的置信度分數和舉報歷史，可快速評估 IP 是否因垃圾郵件、暴力破解或掃描活動而被標記。
use_cases: Check an IP address's community-reported abuse history before investigating further
Verify whether a source IP in server logs is a known bad actor
Report abusive IP addresses to help the community flag malicious infrastructure
use_cases_zh_tw: 在進一步調查前，檢查 IP 地址由社群通報的濫用歷史記錄
驗證伺服器日誌中的來源 IP 是否為已知的惡意行為者
舉報有濫用行為的 IP 地址，以協助社群標記惡意基礎設施

name: BGP.he.net
raw_description: BGP routing information, ASN lookups, and network peering data by Hurricane Electric.
description_en: Free BGP and network routing intelligence tool by Hurricane Electric. Look up ASN details, IP prefixes, peering relationships, and routing paths. Useful for mapping an organization's full IP address range and understanding their internet connectivity.
description_zh_tw: BGP.he.net 是 Hurricane Electric 提供的免費 BGP 和網路路由情報工具，可查詢 ASN 詳情、IP 前綴、對等關係和路由路徑，有助於繪製組織的完整 IP 地址範圍。
use_cases: Look up all IP prefixes and ASNs registered to a target organization
Map peering relationships to understand an organization's internet routing topology
Find CIDR blocks associated with a suspicious ASN for further IP investigation
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢註冊給目標組織的所有 IP 前綴和 ASN
映射對等連結關係以瞭解組織的網際網路路由拓撲
尋找與可疑 ASN 關聯的 CIDR 區塊以進行進一步的 IP 調查

name: TinEye
raw_description: Reverse image search engine.
description_en: Reverse image search engine that finds where an image appears online, tracks image usage history, and identifies the oldest known version of a photo. Useful for verifying image provenance and detecting stock photo or stolen image misuse.
description_zh_tw: TinEye 是反向圖片搜尋引擎，可找到圖片在網路上出現的位置，追蹤圖片使用歷史，並識別照片最早的已知版本，有助於驗證圖片出處和檢測圖片盜用。
use_cases: Verify when and where an image first appeared online to detect fabricated context
Identify stock photo usage in fake profile pictures or disinformation campaigns
Track unauthorized redistribution of copyrighted images across the web
use_cases_zh_tw: 驗證圖片首次出現在網路上的時間和地點，以偵測捏造的背景資訊
在虛假頭像或虛假訊息宣傳活動中識別圖庫相片的使用
追蹤受版權保護圖片在網路上的未授權再散布情況

name: Yandex Images
raw_description: Reverse image search by Yandex, particularly strong for Eastern European and Russian content.
description_en: Yandex's reverse image search is widely considered superior to Google for identifying people in photographs, especially in Eastern European and Russian contexts. Often surfaces social profile matches that Google misses, making it essential for international identity verification.
description_zh_tw: Yandex 的反向圖片搜尋在識別照片中的人物方面被廣泛認為優於 Google，尤其是在東歐和俄語情境中，常常能找到 Google 錯過的社交個人資料匹配。
use_cases: Perform reverse image search for persons when Google returns insufficient results
Identify Eastern European or Russian social media profiles from a photograph
Cross-validate face-based search results against multiple reverse image engines
use_cases_zh_tw: 當 Google 傳回的結果不足時，對人像進行反向圖片搜尋
從相片中識別東歐或俄羅斯的社群媒體個人檔案
對比多個反向影像引擎來交叉驗證人臉搜尋結果

name: OpenCorporates
raw_description: The largest open database of companies in the world.
description_en: World's largest open database of company registration data, covering 200+ jurisdictions. Search by company name or registration number to retrieve official filing details, registered addresses, directors, and corporate relationships — all from public registry sources.
description_zh_tw: OpenCorporates 是全球最大的公司注冊資料開放資料庫，覆蓋 200 多個司法管轄區，可透過公司名稱或注冊號碼查詢官方備案詳情、注冊地址、董事和企業關係。
use_cases: Verify a company's legal status, registered address, and active filings across jurisdictions
Trace corporate ownership chains to identify beneficial owners or shell companies
Investigate a director's other company affiliations and related corporate structures
use_cases_zh_tw: 驗證公司在各司法管轄區的法定地位、註冊地址和活躍申報記錄
追蹤企業所有權鏈以識別實質受益人或空殼公司
調查董事的其他公司任職與關聯企業結構

name: Crunchbase
raw_description: Business intelligence on companies, investors, and funding.
description_en: Business intelligence platform covering startup and corporate funding rounds, acquisitions, key personnel, investors, and company timelines. Useful for building a financial and organizational profile of a target company and tracing investor relationships.
description_zh_tw: Crunchbase 是覆蓋初創公司和企業融資輪次、收購、關鍵人員、投資者和公司發展歷程的商業情報平台，有助於建立目標公司的財務和組織概況。
use_cases: Research a company's funding history, investors, and key personnel for due diligence
Identify executive team members and their professional backgrounds
Trace acquisition and investment relationships between corporate entities
use_cases_zh_tw: 研究公司的融資歷史、投資者和關鍵人員以進行盡職調查
識別高階主管團隊成員及其專業背景
追蹤企業實體之間的收購與投資關係

name: Companies House
raw_description: UK company registration and filing data from Companies House.
description_en: Official UK government company registry providing free access to all registered company filings including accounts, director appointments, and shareholder information. Authoritative source for investigating UK-registered entities.
description_zh_tw: 英國官方公司注冊局，提供免費訪問所有注冊公司備案，包括賬目、董事任命和股東信息，是調查英國注冊實體的權威來源。
use_cases: Verify the legal status and filing history of a UK-registered company
Identify current and resigned directors of a UK company under investigation
Download official company accounts to assess financial health and undisclosed liabilities
use_cases_zh_tw: 驗證在英國註冊的公司的法定地位和申報歷史
識別接受調查的英國公司現任及已離任董事
下載官方公司帳目以評估財務狀況和未揭露的負債

name: LinkedIn
raw_description: Professional social network for career and corporate intelligence.
description_en: Professional social network and essential source for corporate OSINT. Employee profiles reveal job titles, tenure, skills, connections, and company affiliations. Useful for identifying organizational structure, key personnel, and technology stack clues from job listings.
description_zh_tw: LinkedIn 是專業社交網絡，也是企業 OSINT 的重要來源。員工資料揭示職位、任期、技能和公司關係，有助於識別組織結構、關鍵人員。
use_cases: Map an organization's employee structure, reporting lines, and key technical staff
Infer technology stack and security posture from job postings and engineer profiles
Identify recent departures and new hires that may indicate organizational changes
use_cases_zh_tw: 映射組織的員工結構、匯報關係與關鍵技術人員
從職缺公告和工程師檔案推導技術棧與安全狀態
識別近期離職和新聘人員，這可能指出組織結構變動

name: DeHashed
raw_description: Hacked database search engine for breach data.
description_en: Breach data search engine that indexes leaked databases and allows queries by email, username, IP, name, phone, or password hash. Returns the specific breach source and exposed fields for each match. Paid subscription required for full results.
description_zh_tw: DeHashed 是一個索引洩露資料庫的突破資料搜尋引擎，允許通過電子郵件、用戶名、IP、姓名、電話或密碼哈希查詢，返回每個匹配的特定洩露來源和暴露字段。
use_cases: Search by email or username to identify all known breach sources exposing an account
Retrieve password hashes associated with a target for forensic analysis
Cross-reference multiple data points (name + phone) to confirm identity in breach records
ethics_note: Contains leaked credentials and personal data. Use only for lawful security assessments or to verify your own account exposure. Never use retrieved credentials for unauthorized access.
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過電子郵件或使用者名稱搜尋，以識別暴露帳號的所有已知外洩來源
檢索與目標關聯的密碼雜湊值（Hash）以進行鑑識分析
在資料外洩記錄中交叉比對多個數據點（姓名 + 電話）以確認身份

name: LeakCheck.io
raw_description: Email and username breach lookup service.
description_en: Breach lookup service that queries a regularly updated database of leaked credentials by email, username, phone, or domain. Returns breach sources with details on what data was exposed. Offers API access for bulk checks.
description_zh_tw: LeakCheck.io 是一個定期更新的洩露憑證查詢服務，可通過電子郵件、用戶名、電話或域名查詢，返回洩露來源及暴露的數據詳情，並提供批量查詢的 API 訪問。
use_cases: Check an email address against a continuously updated breach database
Bulk-check an organization's email domain for credential exposure using the API
Verify whether a phone number appears in known breach datasets
ethics_note: Returned data may include passwords and personal identifiers. Use only for authorized exposure assessment. Do not store or redistribute returned credential data.
use_cases_zh_tw: 對比持續更新的資料外洩資料庫檢查電子郵件地址
使用 API 批次檢查組織的電子郵件網域是否存在憑證外洩
驗證電話號碼是否出現在已知的外洩數據集中

name: Breach Directory
raw_description: Free breach database lookup tool.
description_en: Free breach lookup tool that checks email addresses against a large dataset of known data breaches. Returns the breach name and a partial preview of exposed data. A useful free starting point before using paid services like DeHashed.
description_zh_tw: Breach Directory 是免費的洩露資料庫查詢工具，可對已知資料洩露的大型數據集檢查電子郵件地址，返回洩露名稱和暴露數據的部分預覽，是使用 DeHashed 等付費服務前有用的免費起點。
use_cases: Quickly check an email address for breach exposure without a paid subscription
Identify which breach events affected a target email as a starting point
Combine with HIBP results for a more complete breach coverage picture
ethics_note: Contains leaked personal data. Use only for authorized exposure assessment.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在沒有付費訂閱的情況下，快速檢查電子郵件地址是否暴露於外洩事件中
識別哪些外洩事件影響了目標電子郵件，以此作為調查起點
結合 HIBP 結果以獲得更完整的資料外洩覆蓋全貌

name: VirusTotal
raw_description: Analyze files and URLs for malware using 70+ antivirus engines.
description_en: Multi-engine file and URL analysis platform that aggregates results from 70+ antivirus engines, sandbox analysis, and community threat intelligence. Also provides domain and IP enrichment with DNS history, WHOIS data, and passive DNS. An essential first lookup in any threat investigation.
description_zh_tw: VirusTotal 是多引擎文件和 URL 分析平台，聚合 70 多個防病毒引擎、沙盒分析和社群威脅情報的結果，同時提供帶有 DNS 歷史、WHOIS 數據和被動 DNS 的域名和 IP 豐富化功能。
use_cases: Analyze a suspicious URL or file hash against 70+ engines to check for malware
Enrich a domain or IP with passive DNS history and community threat tags
Identify which threat actor campaigns have used a specific file hash or infrastructure
use_cases_zh_tw: 對比 70 多個引擎分析可疑 URL 或檔案雜湊值以檢查惡意軟體
利用被動 DNS 歷史和社群威脅標籤豐富網域或 IP 資訊
識別威脅主體活動曾使用過哪些特定檔案雜湊值或基礎設施

name: URLScan.io
raw_description: Website scanner that takes a screenshot and analyzes loaded resources.
description_en: Website sandbox scanner that loads a URL in an isolated browser, captures a full screenshot, and records all network requests, redirects, loaded scripts, and DNS lookups. Useful for safely analyzing suspicious URLs without exposing your own browser to potential threats.
description_zh_tw: URLScan.io 是網站沙盒掃描器，在隔離瀏覽器中加載 URL，捕獲完整截圖，並記錄所有網絡請求、重定向、加載的腳本和 DNS 查詢，有助於安全地分析可疑 URL。
use_cases: Safely analyze a suspicious or phishing URL without opening it in your own browser
Capture a screenshot and resource list for a potentially malicious website as evidence
Review historical scans of a domain to track changes in its hosted content over time
use_cases_zh_tw: 安全地分析可疑或網路釣魚 URL，而無需在您自己的瀏覽器中開啟它
擷取潛在惡意網站的螢幕截圖和資源清單作為證據
審查網域的歷史掃描記錄，以追蹤其託管內容隨時間的變更

name: AlienVault OTX
raw_description: Open threat intelligence community and threat data platform.
description_en: Open threat intelligence community where security researchers share indicators of compromise (IoCs) including malicious IPs, domains, file hashes, and attack patterns. Search for a domain or IP to retrieve community-sourced threat tags and associated attack pulses.
description_zh_tw: AlienVault OTX 是開放的威脅情報社群，安全研究人員在此分享妥協指標（IoCs），包括惡意 IP、域名、文件哈希和攻擊模式。可搜尋域名或 IP 以獲取社群標籤的威脅標籤。
use_cases: Search a suspicious domain or IP for community-reported threat intelligence
Look up a file hash to check if it's associated with known malware campaigns
Retrieve related attack pulses and IoCs to understand a threat actor's infrastructure
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋可疑網域或 IP 的社群回報威脅情報
查詢檔案雜湊值以檢查其是否與已知的惡意軟體活動關聯
檢索相關的攻擊脈絡與 IoC 以瞭解威脅主體的基礎設施

name: Social Blade
raw_description: Social media statistics and analytics tracker.
description_en: Social media analytics platform tracking subscriber/follower counts, growth trends, estimated earnings, and historical statistics for YouTube, Twitch, Twitter/X, Instagram, and TikTok accounts. Useful for detecting artificial growth patterns indicative of botting or coordinated manipulation.
description_zh_tw: Social Blade 是追蹤 YouTube、Twitch、Twitter/X、Instagram 和 TikTok 帳號的訂閱者/粉絲數量、增長趨勢、估計收益和歷史統計數據的社交媒體分析平台，有助於檢測機器人操縱模式。
use_cases: Detect abnormal follower growth spikes that indicate purchased followers or botting
Track historical subscriber counts to estimate when content went viral or was suppressed
Compare growth trajectories across multiple social accounts for coordinated behavior analysis
use_cases_zh_tw: 偵測指出購買粉絲或機器人活動的異常粉絲成長高峰
追蹤歷史訂閱者數量，以評估內容何時瘋傳或被壓制
比較多個社群帳號的成長軌跡以進行協同行為分析

name: Nitter
raw_description: Alternative Twitter/X front-end without JavaScript tracking.
description_en: Privacy-focused alternative Twitter/X front-end that lets you browse tweets, profiles, and search results without a login or JavaScript. Useful for passive observation of public Twitter accounts without alerting the target through algorithmic recommendation exposure.
description_zh_tw: Nitter 是注重隱私的替代 Twitter/X 前端，無需登錄或 JavaScript 即可瀏覽推文、個人資料和搜尋結果，有助於被動觀察公開 Twitter 帳號而不讓算法推薦暴露調查行為。
use_cases: Browse a target's Twitter timeline and media without logging in or triggering recommendations
Search Twitter content and hashtags passively without creating an investigator account
Archive target tweets for evidence without interacting with the account
use_cases_zh_tw: 在不登入或不觸發推薦演算法的情況下，瀏覽目標的 Twitter 時間軸和媒體
被動搜尋 Twitter 內容和標籤，而無需建立調查人員帳號
封存目標推文作為證據，而不與該帳號發生任何互動

name: Social Analyzer
raw_description: Analyze and find a person's profile across 1000+ social media sites.
description_en: Open-source tool that searches for a person's profiles across 1000+ social media and web platforms. Provides confidence scores for matches and can extract profile metadata. More comprehensive platform coverage than Sherlock with a web UI option.
description_zh_tw: Social Analyzer 是開源工具，可在 1000 多個社交媒體和網絡平台上搜尋一個人的個人資料，為匹配提供置信度分數，並可提取個人資料元數據。
use_cases: Search for a person's profiles across 1000+ platforms with confidence scoring
Extract publicly available profile metadata from discovered accounts
Generate an investigation report from multi-platform username results
use_cases_zh_tw: 在 1000 多個平台上搜尋個人的檔案，並提供可信度評分
從發現的帳號中提取公開可用的個人檔案後設資料（Metadata）
從跨平台使用者名稱結果生成調查報告

name: Google Earth
raw_description: Satellite imagery and street-level geolocation tool.
description_en: Satellite and aerial imagery platform with historical imagery layers and Street View. Essential for geolocation investigations — identify building architecture, vegetation patterns, terrain features, and infrastructure to confirm or rule out claimed locations.
description_zh_tw: Google Earth 是帶有歷史影像層和街景的衛星和航空影像平台，是地理定位調查的核心工具，可識別建築架構、植被模式、地形特徵和基礎設施以確認或排除聲稱位置。
use_cases: Geolocate a photograph by matching visible landmarks, terrain, and vegetation to satellite imagery
Compare historical satellite imagery to verify when structures were built or demolished
Corroborate claimed locations in user-generated content using Street View and aerial views
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過比對可見地標、地形和植被與衛星影像，對相片進行地理定位
比對歷史衛星影像以驗證建築物何時建造或拆除
使用街景服務與鳥瞰視角佐證使用者生成內容中所聲稱的位置

name: FOCA
raw_description: Fingerprinting Organizations with Collected Archives.
description_en: Metadata extraction and analysis tool for documents discovered via search engines. Fingerprints an organization by extracting author names, software versions, internal network paths, and printer names from publicly downloadable Office, PDF, and other document files.
description_zh_tw: FOCA 是通過搜尋引擎發現的文件的元數據提取和分析工具，透過從公開可下載的 Office、PDF 等文件中提取作者名稱、軟件版本、內部網絡路徑和打印機名稱來對組織進行指紋識別。
use_cases: Extract author usernames, software versions, and internal paths from public documents
Identify internal infrastructure details from metadata in published PDF and Office files
Map an organization's technology stack from leaked document metadata
use_cases_zh_tw: 從公開文件中提取作者使用者名稱、軟體版本和內部路徑
從發布的 PDF 和 Office 檔案的後設資料中識別內部基礎設施細節
從外洩的文件後設資料映射組織的技術棧

name: OS-Surveillance
raw_description: Real-time intelligence from social media, cameras, and IoT.
description_en: Real-time intelligence aggregation platform combining social media streams, publicly accessible cameras, IoT device feeds, and emergency alert data (AMBER Alerts). Restricted to authorized law enforcement and security contexts due to high privacy sensitivity.
description_zh_tw: OS-Surveillance 是即時情報聚合平台，整合社交媒體流、公開攝影機、物聯網設備和緊急警報數據（如 AMBER Alert），因高隱私敏感性僅限授權執法和安全情境使用。
use_cases: Real-time monitoring of social media activity and public cameras in a specific geographic area
Rapidly aggregate multi-source intelligence to support decision-making during critical incidents
Track AMBER Alerts and crime alerts in a region during authorized investigations
ethics_note: Aggregates surveillance camera and social media data. High privacy risk. Requires explicit legal mandate or law enforcement authorization. Not suitable for civilian or private use without authorization.
use_cases_zh_tw: 即時監控特定地理區域的社群媒體活動和公共監視器
快速彙整多源情報，以支持重大事件期間的決策制定
在授權調查期間追蹤區域內安珀警報（AMBER Alerts）和犯罪警報

name: SEC EDGAR
raw_description: US Securities and Exchange Commission public filing database.
description_en: Official US SEC database containing all public company filings: annual reports (10-K), quarterly reports (10-Q), proxy statements, insider trading disclosures (Forms 3/4/5), and IPO prospectuses. Free, full-text searchable. Authoritative source for US publicly traded companies.
description_zh_tw: 美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的公開申報資料庫，涵蓋上市公司年報（10-K）、季報（10-Q）、委託書聲明、內部人交易揭露及 IPO 招股書，是美國上市公司的權威資料來源。
use_cases: Look up a US company's financial filings, executive compensation, and beneficial ownership
Identify insider stock transactions and large shareholder positions (Form 13F/13G/13D)
Research the background of a public company's officers and board members
curation_reason: Official US government source. High signal-to-noise ratio for corporate OSINT.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢美國公司的財務申報、高階主管薪酬和實質受益所有權
識別內部人股權交易與大股東持股部位（Form 13F/13G/13D）
研究上市公司主管和董事會成員的背景

name: PACER
raw_description: Public Access to Court Electronic Records — US federal court documents.
description_en: US federal court electronic records system providing access to case filings, dockets, and documents from all 94 US District Courts, 13 Circuit Courts of Appeals, and the US Bankruptcy Courts. Low per-page access fee. Invaluable for litigation research and background investigations.
description_zh_tw: 美國聯邦法院電子案卷系統（PACER），提供全美 94 個地區法院、13 個上訴巡迴法院及破產法院的案件卷宗和文件，是訴訟研究和背景調查的必備資源。
use_cases: Search for civil or criminal lawsuits involving a company or individual
Access bankruptcy filings to understand a company's financial distress history
Retrieve court-ordered discovery documents and settlement records
curation_reason: Primary source for US federal court records. No substitute for this data.
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋涉及公司或個人的民事或刑事訴訟
存取破產申報以瞭解公司的財務困境歷史
檢索法院命令的開示程序文件和和解記錄

name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database
raw_description: ICIJ database of offshore companies from Panama Papers, Paradise Papers, Pandora Papers, and other leaks.
description_en: International Consortium of Investigative Journalists' searchable database of over 800,000 offshore entities from major leaks including Panama Papers, Paradise Papers, Pandora Papers, and Bahamas Leaks. Links companies, officers, and intermediaries with registered addresses and beneficial owners.
description_zh_tw: 國際調查記者同盟（ICIJ）的離岸公司資料庫，收錄巴拿馬文件、天堂文件、潘朵拉文件等重大洩露事件中逾 80 萬個離岸實體，並關聯公司、高管與中間人資訊。
use_cases: Search whether a company or individual appears in any major offshore document leak
Trace beneficial ownership of shell companies through the interconnected entity graph
Cross-reference offshore entities with known sanctions targets or PEPs
curation_reason: Unique dataset unavailable elsewhere. Critical for financial crime investigations.
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋公司或個人是否出現在任何重大的離岸文件洩漏事件中
透過相互連結的實體圖追蹤空殼公司的實質受益所有權
將離岸實體與已知的制裁目標或 PEP 進行交叉比對

name: OpenSanctions
raw_description: Open database of sanctioned entities, politically exposed persons, and persons of interest.
description_en: Open-source database aggregating global sanctions lists, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and criminal watchlists from over 100 sources including OFAC, UN Security Council, EU, and Interpol. Freely searchable with API access. Used in KYC, compliance, and investigative journalism.
description_zh_tw: 彙整全球制裁名單、政治曝光人士（PEP）及犯罪監控名單的開源資料庫，來源超過 100 個，包含 OFAC、聯合國安理會、歐盟及國際刑警組織，支援 API 存取。
use_cases: Check whether an individual or entity appears on any global sanctions list
Screen for politically exposed persons (PEPs) during KYC or due diligence
Build a compliance watchlist pipeline using the free API
curation_reason: Best free alternative to commercial compliance databases like Refinitiv.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查個人或實體是否出現在任何全球制裁清單中
在 KYC 或盡職調查期間篩選政治顯要人物（PEPs）
使用免費 API 建立合規觀察清單管道

name: MuckRock
raw_description: Platform for filing and sharing FOIA requests in the US.
description_en: Collaborative platform for filing, tracking, and sharing Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests with US federal, state, and local agencies. Hosts a public archive of thousands of released government documents. Simplifies the FOIA process and crowdsources government transparency.
description_zh_tw: MuckRock 是美國資訊自由法（FOIA）申請的協作平台，支援向聯邦、州及地方政府機關提交、追蹤及分享申請，並公開已取得的政府文件檔案庫。
use_cases: File a FOIA request to a US government agency and track its progress
Search the archive of already-released FOIA documents from other requesters
Access police reports, surveillance records, and other government materials
curation_reason: Best workflow tool for FOIA-based journalism and research.
use_cases_zh_tw: 向美國政府機構提出資訊自由法（FOIA）申請並追蹤其進度
搜尋來自其他申請人已釋出 FOIA 文件的封存檔案
獲取警政報告、監視記錄和其他政府資料

name: GovInfo
raw_description: Official digital repository of US federal government publications.
description_en: US Government Publishing Office (GPO) official repository providing free access to congressional records, Federal Register notices, Code of Federal Regulations, GAO reports, budget documents, and thousands of other official federal publications. Authoritative, full-text searchable, with bulk download API.
description_zh_tw: 美國政府出版局（GPO）的官方數位典藏庫，免費提供國會記錄、聯邦公報通知、聯邦法規彙編、GAO 報告及預算文件等大量聯邦政府出版品。
use_cases: Search Federal Register for agency rulemaking notices mentioning a specific company
Access historical congressional hearing transcripts and committee reports
Download GAO audit reports and inspector general findings
curation_reason: Official USG source; uniquely authoritative for federal documents.
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋聯邦公報中提及特定公司的機構制定規則通知
存取歷史國會聽證會逐字稿和委員會報告
下載政府問責署（GAO）審計報告和監察長調查結果

name: Judyrecords
raw_description: Search engine for US court cases across all 50 states.
description_en: Free aggregated search engine covering over 600 million US court case records from state and federal courts. Search by party name, attorney, case number, or court. Broader state-level coverage than PACER. Useful for quickly surfacing litigation history before deep-diving into primary court dockets.
description_zh_tw: 免費的美國法院案件搜尋引擎，收錄超過 6 億筆州及聯邦法院案件記錄，可依當事人姓名、律師、案號或法院搜尋，涵蓋範圍廣於 PACER。
use_cases: Quickly check if a person or company has litigation history across US states
Find case numbers before accessing full records in primary court systems
Screen a potential business partner for undisclosed legal disputes
curation_reason: Fills the gap for state court records not easily accessible via PACER.
use_cases_zh_tw: 快速檢查個人或公司在美國各州是否有訴訟歷史記錄
在存取主要法院系統的完整記錄前先尋找案號
篩選潛在商業合作夥伴是否有未揭露的法律糾紛

name: World Bank Contracts
raw_description: World Bank procurement and contracts database.
description_en: World Bank Group public database of procurement contracts, awarded vendors, project financing, and debarment lists. Useful for tracking companies receiving international development funding, identifying conflict-of-interest patterns, and researching entities banned from World Bank projects.
description_zh_tw: 世界銀行集團的採購合約、得標廠商、項目融資及禁止名單公開資料庫，適合追蹤獲得國際發展資金的企業、識別利益衝突模式及調查被世銀禁止的實體。
use_cases: Check if a company is on the World Bank debarment list
Research which contractors receive World Bank-funded infrastructure contracts
Identify cross-border funding patterns for corruption investigations
curation_reason: Unique international scope for development finance and procurement research.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查公司是否在世界銀行排除名單（Debarment list）中
研究哪些承包商獲得世界銀行資助的基礎建設合約
為貪腐調查識別跨國資金模式

name: InVID / WeVerify
raw_description: Browser extension for verifying online videos and images.
description_en: EU-funded browser extension for journalists and fact-checkers. Extracts video keyframes for reverse image search, detects metadata, checks Twitter API context, and scores image authenticity using AI. Supported by AFP, BBC, Google News Lab. Indispensable for visual content verification.
description_zh_tw: 歐盟資助的瀏覽器擴充套件，專為記者和事實核查人員設計，可提取影片關鍵幀、反向搜尋圖像、偵測元數據、查詢 Twitter API 上下文，並以 AI 評分圖像真實性。
use_cases: Verify whether a viral video was filmed at the claimed time and location
Extract keyframes from a video and run reverse image search on each frame
Check image metadata and detect signs of manipulation or tampering
curation_reason: Industry-standard tool for image/video verification used by major news outlets.
use_cases_zh_tw: 驗證瘋傳影片是否在聲稱的時間和地點拍攝
從影片中提取關鍵畫格，並對每個畫格執行反向影像搜尋
檢查圖片後設資料並偵測是否有修改或竄改的跡象

name: Hunchly
raw_description: Web capture tool for OSINT investigations.
description_en: Browser extension that automatically captures and archives every web page you visit during an investigation, with automatic hashing for evidentiary integrity. Generates case reports, highlights keywords, and provides a timeline of captured evidence. Paid but considered gold standard for professional investigators.
description_zh_tw: Hunchly 是瀏覽器擴充套件，在調查過程中自動捕獲並存檔每個訪問的網頁，並進行雜湊驗證以確保證據完整性，生成案件報告和關鍵字高亮時間軸。
use_cases: Automatically capture and preserve web evidence during a live investigation
Build an auditable evidence trail with timestamped, hashed page captures
Generate a case report from captured web pages with keyword highlights
curation_reason: Gold standard for professional web evidence collection and case management.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在即時調查期間自動擷取並保存網頁證據
使用帶有時間戳記、已雜湊的網頁擷取建立可審計的證據軌跡
從擷取的網頁中生成帶有關鍵字標示的案件報告

name: FotoForensics
raw_description: Image analysis and forgery detection tool.
description_en: Free online image forensics tool that analyzes photos for manipulation using Error Level Analysis (ELA), metadata inspection, and lighting analysis. ELA reveals regions where JPEG compression differs — a strong indicator of pixel-level editing or compositing. Useful for detecting digitally altered images.
description_zh_tw: 免費的線上圖像鑑識工具，使用誤差等級分析（ELA）、元數據檢查和光照分析來偵測照片是否遭到竄改，ELA 可揭示 JPEG 壓縮差異，是識別像素級編輯的有效指標。
use_cases: Run Error Level Analysis on a suspicious image to detect areas that were edited or composited
Extract EXIF metadata to check device, timestamp, and GPS coordinates
Verify whether a document scan or photograph has been digitally altered
curation_reason: Accessible ELA-based image verification with no account required.
use_cases_zh_tw: 對可疑圖片執行誤差水平分析（Error Level Analysis）以偵測被編輯或合成的區域
提取 EXIF 後設資料以檢查裝置、時間戳記和 GPS 座標
驗證文件掃描檔或相片是否經過數位修改

name: AI Image Detector (Hive)
raw_description: AI-generated image and text detection by Hive Moderation.
description_en: Hive Moderation's free AI-generated content detector that classifies images and text as AI-generated or human-created. Supports detection of outputs from Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, and GPT models. Useful for fact-checking synthetic media, profile photo verification, and disinformation research.
description_zh_tw: Hive Moderation 的免費 AI 生成內容偵測器，可判斷圖像和文字是否由 AI 生成，支援偵測 Stable Diffusion、DALL-E、Midjourney 及 GPT 的輸出，適用於合成媒體事實核查。
use_cases: Determine whether a profile photo was generated by an AI image model
Scan text passages to detect if they were written by a large language model
Verify whether an image used in a news story or social post is AI-generated
curation_reason: Most accessible free AI image/text detection with reliable accuracy.
use_cases_zh_tw: 判斷個人頭像是否由 AI 影像模型所生成
掃描文本段落以偵測它們是否由大型語言模型所撰寫
驗證新聞報導或社群貼文中所使用的圖片是否為 AI 生成

name: Deepware Scanner
raw_description: Deepfake video detection tool.
description_en: Free deepfake detection service that analyzes video files to identify whether faces have been synthetically swapped or manipulated using deep learning models. Provides a confidence score and highlights suspect frames. Useful for verifying video evidence in investigations involving fabricated footage.
description_zh_tw: Deepware 是免費的深度偽造影片偵測服務，分析影片文件以識別是否使用深度學習模型進行人臉合成或操作，提供可信度分數並標出可疑幀。
use_cases: Check whether a video shows genuine footage or a deepfake face-swap
Verify video evidence submitted in legal or journalistic contexts
Screen social media videos for synthetic face manipulation before reporting
curation_reason: Only easily accessible free deepfake video detector in the public domain.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查影片顯示的是真實畫面還是 Deepfake 深偽換臉
驗證在法律或新聞調查背景下提交的影片證據
在舉報前篩選社群媒體影片中是否有合成人臉篡改

name: Skopenow
raw_description: AI-powered social media and public records investigation platform.
description_en: AI-powered OSINT platform that aggregates and analyzes social media profiles, public records, and behavioral data to generate comprehensive investigation reports. Used by insurance investigators, law firms, and corporations for claims research and due diligence. Automated report generation from a subject name.
description_zh_tw: Skopenow 是 AI 驅動的 OSINT 平台，聚合並分析社交媒體個人資料、公開記錄和行為數據以生成全面的調查報告，廣泛用於保險調查、法律事務所和企業盡職調查。
use_cases: Generate an automated social media and public records report on a claims subject
Screen a contractor or employee candidate across social platforms and public records
Collect behavioral intelligence from public social posts for litigation support
ethics_note: Automated aggregation of public social data. Use only for authorized investigations in compliance with local privacy laws. Jurisdictions vary on legality of social media evidence.
curation_reason: Representative AI-powered OSINT platform in professional investigative use.
use_cases_zh_tw: 針對理賠對象生成自動化的社群媒體與公共記錄報告
在社群平台與公共記錄中篩選承包商或員工候選人
從公開的社群貼文中收集行為情報以支援訴訟

name: ANY.RUN
raw_description: Interactive online malware sandbox.
description_en: Interactive online malware sandbox that allows analysts to observe the full execution behavior of suspicious files and URLs in a real Windows or Linux virtual machine — without running the sample locally. Real-time process tree, network connections, file system changes, and registry modifications are all visible. Free tier available.
description_zh_tw: ANY.RUN 是互動式線上惡意軟體沙箱，允許分析人員在真實的 Windows 或 Linux 虛擬機中觀察可疑文件和 URL 的完整執行行為，即時顯示進程樹、網絡連接、文件系統變更及登錄檔修改。
use_cases: Execute a suspicious file in an isolated VM and observe its behavior in real time
Analyze network connections made by malware to identify C2 servers
Share a sandbox session link with colleagues for collaborative threat analysis
curation_reason: Interactive sandbox unique in its class; widely used by SOC analysts.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在隔離的虛擬機器（VM）中執行可疑檔案，並即時觀察其行為
分析惡意軟體建立的網路連線以識別 C2 伺服器
與同事分享沙箱工作階段連結以進行協同威脅分析

name: Hybrid Analysis
raw_description: Free malware analysis service powered by CrowdStrike Falcon Sandbox.
description_en: Free malware analysis service powered by CrowdStrike Falcon Sandbox. Analyzes files and URLs to detect threats, extracts indicators of compromise (IOCs), generates YARA rules, and provides detailed behavioral reports. Supports PE, Office, PDF, JAR, and script file types. Submit samples without requiring account.
description_zh_tw: 由 CrowdStrike Falcon 沙箱驅動的免費惡意軟體分析服務，分析文件和 URL 以偵測威脅、提取入侵指標（IOC）、生成 YARA 規則，支援 PE、Office、PDF、JAR 及腳本文件類型。
use_cases: Submit a suspicious attachment to get a behavioral analysis report
Extract IOCs (hashes, IPs, domains) from malware for threat intelligence enrichment
Search existing reports by file hash to check if a sample is already known
curation_reason: CrowdStrike-backed free sandbox; highest-quality free static+dynamic analysis.
use_cases_zh_tw: 提交可疑的附件以獲取行為分析報告
從惡意軟體中提取 IOC（雜湊值、IP、網域）以富集威脅情報
依檔案雜湊值搜尋現有報告，以檢查樣本是否已為已知

name: MalwareBazaar
raw_description: Free malware sample sharing project by abuse.ch.
description_en: Abuse.ch's free community platform for sharing and searching malware samples. Submit malicious files, query by SHA256 hash, YARA rule, tag, or file type, and download samples for offline analysis. Part of the Abuse.ch threat intelligence ecosystem alongside URLhaus and Feodo Tracker.
description_zh_tw: Abuse.ch 的免費社群平台，用於分享和搜尋惡意軟體樣本。可提交惡意文件、以 SHA256 雜湊值、YARA 規則、標籤或文件類型查詢，並下載樣本進行離線分析。
use_cases: Check if a file hash matches a known malware sample in the community database
Download a malware sample by SHA256 for offline research or YARA rule testing
Track newly uploaded malware samples by family or tag in real time
ethics_note: Contains live malware samples. Download and execute only in isolated, air-gapped analysis environments. Do not run samples on production or personal systems.
curation_reason: Central community repository for malware samples; essential for threat research.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查檔案雜湊值是否與社群資料庫中的已知惡意軟體樣本匹配
按 SHA256 下載惡意軟體樣本，以進行離線研究或 YARA 規則測試
即時追蹤按家族或標籤分類的新上傳惡意軟體樣本

name: PhishTank
raw_description: Community-verified phishing URL database.
description_en: Community-verified database of phishing URLs submitted and cross-verified by volunteers. Check a URL to determine if it is a known phishing site, or submit newly discovered phishing pages. Free API available for integration into security tooling. Run by Cisco Talos.
description_zh_tw: 由社群志願者提交並交叉驗證的網絡釣魚 URL 資料庫，可查詢 URL 是否為已知釣魚網站或提交新發現的釣魚頁面，提供免費 API，由 Cisco Talos 運營。
use_cases: Check whether a suspicious URL is a known phishing page
Submit newly discovered phishing pages for community verification
Integrate phishing URL data into your email security or threat intelligence pipeline
curation_reason: Long-standing community-verified phishing database with Cisco Talos backing.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查可疑 URL 是否為已知的網路釣魚網頁
提交新發現的網路釣魚網頁以供社群驗證
將網路釣魚 URL 數據整合到您的電子郵件安全或威脅情報管道中

name: URLVoid
raw_description: Website reputation checker aggregating multiple security engines.
description_en: URL reputation aggregator that queries 30+ security engines and blocklists (Google Safe Browsing, McAfee, Bitdefender, ESET, etc.) to assess whether a URL or domain is flagged as malicious, phishing, or spam. Simple, fast, and free. Good first-pass triage before deeper sandbox analysis.
description_zh_tw: URLVoid 是 URL 聲譽聚合器，查詢 30+ 個安全引擎和黑名單（Google 安全瀏覽、McAfee、Bitdefender 等）評估 URL 或域名是否被標記為惡意、釣魚或垃圾郵件。
use_cases: Quickly check a suspicious URL against 30+ reputation engines before clicking
Triage phishing report URLs by checking blocklist coverage
Check if a newly registered domain has already been flagged as malicious
curation_reason: Fast multi-engine URL reputation check; ideal entry point for URL triage.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在點擊前，對比 30 多個信譽引擎快速檢查可疑 URL
透過檢查阻擋清單覆蓋範圍，對通報的網路釣魚 URL 進行分流評估
檢查新註冊的網域是否已被標記為惡意網域

name: Filescan.io
raw_description: Fast file analysis and IOC extraction sandbox.
description_en: Emerging file analysis sandbox focused on speed and accuracy of IOC extraction. Analyzes PE, Office, PDF, and script files with a strong focus on static analysis and YARA signature matching, producing structured JSON reports. Free tier available. Good supplement to Any.RUN for file-focused triage.
description_zh_tw: Filescan.io 是以速度和 IOC 提取準確性為重點的文件分析沙箱，分析 PE、Office、PDF 及腳本文件，強調靜態分析和 YARA 簽名匹配，輸出結構化 JSON 報告。
use_cases: Extract IOCs from a malicious document for threat intelligence enrichment
Perform static malware analysis on a file without full dynamic execution
Integrate with automated alert pipelines via structured JSON report API
curation_reason: Complementary to VirusTotal/ANY.RUN for structured IOC extraction workflows.
use_cases_zh_tw: 從惡意文件中提取 IOC 以富集威脅情報
對檔案執行靜態惡意軟體分析，而無需完整的動態執行
透過結構化 JSON 報告 API 與自動警報管道整合

name: URLhaus
raw_description: Community database of malware distribution URLs by abuse.ch.
description_en: Abuse.ch's community threat intelligence feed tracking active malware distribution URLs. Submit malicious URLs, query by URL, domain, IP, or malware tag, and download blocklists. Part of the abuse.ch ecosystem alongside MalwareBazaar and Feodo Tracker. Free API and bulk data export.
description_zh_tw: Abuse.ch 的社群威脅情報源，追蹤活躍的惡意軟體散布 URL，可提交惡意 URL、以域名、IP 或惡意軟體標籤查詢，並下載封鎖清單。支援免費 API 和批量數據導出。
use_cases: Check whether a URL is actively distributing malware
Download a domain blocklist derived from active malware distribution URLs
Track malware families distributed via specific hosting providers
curation_reason: Essential abuse.ch resource; real-time malware URL intelligence.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查 URL 是否正在主動傳播惡意軟體
下載源自活躍惡意軟體傳播 URL 的網域阻擋清單
追蹤透過特定託管提供商傳播的惡意軟體家族

name: Ahmia
raw_description: Search engine for Tor hidden services.
description_en: Open-source search engine that indexes publicly reachable Tor hidden services (.onion sites). Ahmia filters out child abuse material and can be used on the clearnet to search for .onion site titles and descriptions without needing Tor Browser installed. Useful for brand monitoring and dark web situational awareness from a defensive posture.
description_zh_tw: 開源 Tor 隱藏服務搜尋引擎，索引可公開訪問的 .onion 網站，過濾兒童虐待內容，可在明網上搜尋 .onion 網站的標題和描述，無需安裝 Tor 瀏覽器。適合品牌監控和防禦性暗網態勢感知。
use_cases: Search for public .onion services related to a company or individual without Tor Browser
Check whether brand names or domains appear in indexed dark web service descriptions
Discover public Tor-accessible resources for academic or security research
ethics_note: Use only for lawful, authorized research. Do not use Ahmia results to identify, access, or interact with illegal services. Dark web research carries legal risk in some jurisdictions.
curation_reason: Cleanest, safest entry point for dark web OSINT — clearnet accessible.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在不使用 Tor 瀏覽器的情況下，搜尋與公司或個人相關的公開 .onion 服務
檢查品牌名稱或網域是否出現在已索引的暗網服務說明中
發現學術或安全研究可用的公開 Tor 存取資源

name: DarkSearch.io
raw_description: Dark web search engine with free API.
description_en: Dark web search engine that indexes .onion sites and provides a free API for programmatic querying. Unlike Ahmia, DarkSearch offers more extensive coverage with keyword and boolean search. Clearnet-accessible. Used by researchers and security teams for dark web monitoring. API allows automated brand-mention tracking.
description_zh_tw: 暗網搜尋引擎，索引 .onion 網站並提供免費 API 進行程序化查詢，支援關鍵字和布林搜尋，明網可訪問，適用於研究人員和安全團隊進行暗網監控及自動化品牌提及追蹤。
use_cases: Search dark web content for mentions of a company, domain, or email address
Use the API to build an automated dark web brand monitoring pipeline
Identify dark web forums or markets that reference specific keywords
ethics_note: Index-based searching only. Results must never be used to locate, access, or transact with illegal services. Ensure research complies with local computer crime and privacy laws.
curation_reason: Best free API-accessible dark web search for automated monitoring use cases.
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋暗網內容中是否提及公司、網域或電子郵件地址
使用 API 建立自動化暗網品牌監控管道
識別引用特定關鍵字的暗網論壇或市場

name: Tor Browser
raw_description: The Tor Project's privacy-preserving browser for anonymous internet access.
description_en: Official browser from The Tor Project that routes all traffic through the Tor anonymity network, masking the user's IP address. Required for accessing .onion hidden services. Essential for anonymous OSINT collection and accessing dark web resources safely. Free, open-source. Use in conjunction with Tails OS or Whonix for maximum OPSEC.
description_zh_tw: Tor Project 的官方瀏覽器，將所有流量路由經過 Tor 匿名網絡以遮蔽用戶 IP，是訪問 .onion 隱藏服務的必備工具，也是匿名 OSINT 收集的基礎，建議搭配 Tails OS 或 Whonix 使用。
use_cases: Access .onion hidden services for authorized dark web research
Browse the open web with IP anonymization to protect investigator identity
Collect web evidence from sensitive sources without revealing your real IP
ethics_note: Tor Browser is a legitimate privacy tool. Use only for lawful research. Do not access or transact with illegal services. Exiting Tor to clearnet still exposes exit node IP to destination servers.
curation_reason: Required tool for any Tor/dark web research; canonical open-source project.
use_cases_zh_tw: 存取 .onion 隱藏服務以進行獲授權的暗網研究
以 IP 匿名化瀏覽公開網頁，以保護調查人員身份
從敏感來源收集網頁證據，而不暴露您的真實 IP

name: OnionScan
raw_description: Tool for auditing Tor hidden services for security and deanonymization risks.
description_en: Open-source security scanner for Tor hidden services (.onion sites) that passively checks for configuration errors, metadata leaks, correlation attacks, and deanonymization risks. Used defensively by operators of legitimate onion services to audit security posture. Not used to attack or deanonymize services.
description_zh_tw: 開源 Tor 隱藏服務安全掃描器，被動檢查配置錯誤、元數據洩漏、關聯攻擊和去匿名化風險，由合法洋蔥服務的運營者防禦性使用，用於審計安全狀況。
use_cases: Audit a Tor hidden service you operate for deanonymization vulnerabilities
Detect HTTP header or SSL certificate leaks that could reveal a service's real IP
Verify that a .onion service does not expose server-side metadata
ethics_note: Use only to audit services you operate or have explicit authorization to test. Scanning third-party onion services without permission may violate computer abuse laws.
curation_reason: Unique defensive tool for auditing Tor service security; no mainstream alternative.
use_cases_zh_tw: 對您運作的 Tor 隱藏服務進行去匿名化漏洞審計
偵測可能揭露服務真實 IP 的 HTTP 標頭或 SSL 憑證洩漏
驗證 .onion 服務不會暴露伺服器端後設資料（Metadata）

name: DarkTracer
raw_description: Dark web intelligence platform for credential and brand monitoring.
description_en: Dark web intelligence platform that monitors stealer malware logs, ransomware gang leak sites, and underground forums for credential exposure, brand mentions, and data leaks. Provides alert-based monitoring without requiring users to directly access the dark web. Enterprise-oriented but offers limited free lookups.
description_zh_tw: 暗網情報平台，監控竊取惡意軟體日誌、勒索軟體洩露網站和地下論壇，追蹤憑證暴露、品牌提及和數據洩露，提供警報式監控，無需用戶直接訪問暗網。
use_cases: Monitor your organization's email domains for credentials exposed in stealer logs
Track whether your company is mentioned on ransomware group leak sites
Detect early indicators of a breach from underground forum data before public disclosure
ethics_note: Platform aggregates stolen credential data. Use only to protect organizations you are authorized to monitor. Do not use for personal credential collection or unauthorized access.
curation_reason: Best accessible dark web brand/credential monitoring for non-enterprise teams.
use_cases_zh_tw: 監控您的組織電子郵件網域是否在外洩的憑證日誌中暴露
追蹤您的公司是否在勒索軟體集團的外洩網站上被提及
在公開披露前，從地下論壇數據中偵測早期外洩指標

name: Tails OS
raw_description: Live amnesic operating system for privacy and anonymity.
description_en: Live USB operating system that routes all traffic through Tor by default and leaves no traces on the host computer. Boots from USB stick, stores nothing on disk, and terminates cleanly. Standard recommendation for journalists, activists, and investigators who need strong anonymity and plausible deniability in high-risk environments.
description_zh_tw: Tails 是從 USB 隨身碟啟動的隱身作業系統，預設將所有流量路由經過 Tor，且不在主機留下任何痕跡，是記者、活動人士和高風險環境調查人員的標準匿名工具。
use_cases: Conduct sensitive OSINT research from a clean, amnesic environment
Prevent host machine from logging investigation activities or visited sites
Establish an isolated browsing environment for high-OPSEC investigations
curation_reason: Gold standard investigator OPSEC OS; Tor Project and EFF recommended.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在乾淨、不保留紀錄的環境中進行敏感的 OSINT 研究
防止主機記錄調查活動或瀏覽過的網站
為高 OPSEC 調查建立隔離的瀏覽環境

name: Whonix
raw_description: Privacy-focused operating system routing all traffic through Tor.
description_en: Privacy-focused virtual machine OS that runs all traffic through Tor via a separate Gateway VM and isolated Workstation VM. Unlike Tails, Whonix persists data and is designed for long-term use inside VirtualBox or KVM. Provides strong IP leak protection and is recommended for investigators needing persistent working environments.
description_zh_tw: Whonix 是隱私導向的虛擬機作業系統，通過獨立的 Gateway VM 將所有流量路由經過 Tor，並使用隔離的 Workstation VM，與 Tails 不同，它持久存儲數據，適合需要持久工作環境的調查人員。
use_cases: Run persistent investigations in a Tor-routed VM without exposing real IP
Compartmentalize investigation research from personal computing environment
Test investigative workflows safely inside an isolated virtual machine
curation_reason: Best persistent-use OPSEC OS for investigators who need to save work between sessions.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在 Tor 路由的虛擬機器中執行持續調查，而不暴露真實 IP
將調查研究與個人運算環境進行隔離區分
在隔離的虛擬機器中安全地測試調查工作流程

name: VeraCrypt
raw_description: Open-source disk encryption software.
description_en: Free, open-source disk encryption software for creating encrypted volumes and encrypting full system partitions. Successor to TrueCrypt with additional security improvements. Supports hidden volumes for plausible deniability. Standard tool for protecting sensitive investigation data, source materials, and documents on seized or lost devices.
description_zh_tw: VeraCrypt 是免費開源的磁碟加密軟體，可創建加密卷或加密完整系統分區，支援隱藏卷以實現合理可否認性，是保護調查數據、線人資料和敏感文件免遭設備扣押風險的標準工具。
use_cases: Create an encrypted container for storing investigation notes and sensitive evidence
Enable full-disk encryption on a laptop used for sensitive fieldwork
Use hidden volumes to protect source identities with plausible deniability
curation_reason: Industry-standard open-source disk encryption for evidence and source protection.
use_cases_zh_tw: 建立加密容器以儲存調查筆記與敏感證據
在用於敏感現場調查的筆記型電腦上啟用全磁碟加密
使用隱藏磁碟區保護來源身份，並具有合理的否認性

name: Mullvad VPN
raw_description: Privacy-first no-logs VPN with anonymous account model.
description_en: Swedish no-logs VPN with an anonymous account model (account numbers instead of email addresses), accepts cash and cryptocurrency payments, and has passed independent security audits. Consistently rated among the best VPNs for privacy by security researchers. Suitable for masking investigator IP during clearnet research.
description_zh_tw: 瑞典隱私優先 VPN，採用匿名帳號模型（帳號號碼而非電子郵件），接受現金和加密貨幣付款，並通過獨立安全審計，被安全研究人員評為隱私最佳 VPN 之一。
use_cases: Mask your real IP address while conducting clearnet OSINT research
Establish an investigation environment that does not expose your ISP or location
Use an anonymous payment method to prevent VPN account linkage to your identity
curation_reason: Best-in-class VPN for investigator privacy; anonymous account model is unique.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在進行明網 OSINT 研究時遮蔽您的真實 IP 地址
建立不暴露您的 ISP 或位置的調查環境
使用匿名付款方式，以防止 VPN 帳號連結至您的真實身份

name: Signal
raw_description: End-to-end encrypted private messaging and voice app.
description_en: End-to-end encrypted messaging, voice, and video app using the Signal Protocol — the gold standard for secure communications. Used by journalists, lawyers, human rights workers, and investigators to protect source communications and sensitive coordination. Messages are not stored on Signal's servers.
description_zh_tw: Signal 是使用 Signal 協議的端對端加密即時通訊、語音和視訊應用，是安全通訊的黃金標準，廣泛用於記者、律師、人權工作者和調查人員保護線人通訊和敏感協調。
use_cases: Securely communicate with sources and collaborators during sensitive investigations
Enable disappearing messages to prevent evidence accumulation on devices
Protect investigation coordination from interception on shared or monitored networks
curation_reason: Gold standard secure comms; recommended by EFF, CPJ, and major journalism organizations.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在敏感調查期間，與消息來源及合作夥伴安全地通訊
啟用閱後即焚訊息，以防止證據在裝置上累積
保護調查協調工作，使其免受共享或受監控網路上的攔截

name: BrowserLeaks
raw_description: Browser fingerprinting and privacy leak testing tool.
description_en: Free suite of browser privacy tests that check for WebRTC IP leaks, canvas fingerprinting, font fingerprinting, geolocation exposure, DNS leaks, and other identifiable signals. Use before conducting sensitive investigations to verify that your VPN, Tor, or privacy tools are working correctly and not leaking your real identity.
description_zh_tw: 免費的瀏覽器隱私測試套件，檢查 WebRTC IP 洩漏、Canvas 指紋、字體指紋、地理位置暴露、DNS 洩漏等可識別信號，在敏感調查前使用以確認 VPN 或 Tor 工具未洩露真實身份。
use_cases: Check for WebRTC IP leaks before starting a sensitive investigation session
Verify that Tor Browser or VPN is not exposing your real IP or DNS queries
Test browser fingerprint uniqueness to assess tracking and deanonymization risk
curation_reason: Essential pre-investigation OPSEC check; comprehensive and free.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在開始敏感的調查工作階段前，檢查是否有 WebRTC IP 洩漏
驗證 Tor 瀏覽器或 VPN 是否暴露了您的真實 IP 或 DNS 查詢
測試瀏覽器指紋唯一性以評估追蹤與去匿名化風險

name: PhoneInfoga
raw_description: Advanced information gathering and OSINT framework for phone numbers.
description_en: Open-source OSINT framework for gathering publicly available information on phone numbers. Validates number format, determines carrier and region, queries multiple public sources (Numverify, Google DORK, Ovh), and identifies associated online accounts. CLI and web interface. Passive-only; does not contact the number.
description_zh_tw: 開源電話號碼情報收集框架，驗證號碼格式、確定運營商和地區、查詢多個公開來源（Numverify、Google DORK、Ovh），並識別關聯的線上帳號。僅被動查詢，不直接聯繫號碼。
use_cases: Identify the carrier and geographic region of an unknown phone number
Check whether a phone number is associated with online accounts or leaked datasets
Validate a phone number format and determine country code before investigation
ethics_note: Use only for phone numbers you are authorized to investigate. Phone number lookups may constitute surveillance in some jurisdictions. Confirm legal basis before use.
curation_reason: Most capable open-source phone OSINT tool with passive methodology.
use_cases_zh_tw: 識別未知電話號碼的電信業者和地理區域
檢查電話號碼是否與線上帳號或外洩數據集關聯
在調查前驗證電話號碼格式並確定國碼

name: TrueCaller
raw_description: Global phone number identification and caller ID service.
description_en: Crowdsourced caller ID and phone spam detection service with a database of over 3 billion phone numbers. Users can look up phone numbers to see user-submitted names and spam scores. Note: TrueCaller's database is populated from user contact lists without explicit consent — consider privacy implications before relying on returned data.
description_zh_tw: 眾包來電顯示和電話垃圾偵測服務，擁有超過 30 億個電話號碼資料庫，可查詢電話號碼以查看用戶提交的姓名和垃圾評分。注意：其資料庫從用戶聯絡人名單中未經明確同意收集，使用時需考慮隱私影響。
use_cases: Look up an unknown caller number to identify the associated name or organization
Check whether a phone number has been flagged as spam or fraudulent by the community
Verify contact information consistency when a name and phone number have been provided
ethics_note: Data is crowd-sourced from user contact lists without explicit consent of the individuals named. Results may be inaccurate. Do not use as sole identifying evidence. Consider local privacy laws before use.
curation_reason: Largest global caller ID database; significant despite privacy caveats.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢未知來電號碼以識別關聯的姓名或組織
檢查電話號碼是否已被社群標記為垃圾郵件或詐騙電話
當提供姓名和電話號碼時，驗證聯絡資訊的一致性

name: Numverify
raw_description: Phone number validation and carrier lookup API.
description_en: Phone number validation API that verifies number format, confirms line type (mobile/landline/VOIP), returns carrier name, country code, and geographic region. Used in compliance workflows, fraud detection, and OSINT preprocessing to validate number authenticity before deeper investigation.
description_zh_tw: 電話號碼驗證 API，確認號碼格式、線路類型（手機/固話/VOIP）、返回運營商名稱、國家代碼和地理區域，用於合規工作流程、詐欺偵測和 OSINT 預處理中的號碼真實性驗證。
use_cases: Validate whether a phone number is active and determine its carrier
Classify whether a number is mobile, landline, or VOIP
Enrich investigation leads by appending carrier and geographic data to phone numbers
curation_reason: Standard phone validation API for carrier and format intelligence.
use_cases_zh_tw: 驗證電話號碼是否為有效號碼並確定其電信業者
分類號碼是行動電話、市話還是 VOIP 電話
透過向電話號碼附加電信業者與地理數據來富集調查線索

name: OpenCNAM
raw_description: US Caller ID (CNAM) lookup API.
description_en: US Caller ID Name (CNAM) lookup API that queries the authoritative US CNAM databases to return the registered name associated with a US telephone number. Useful for verifying caller identity in the US context. Paid per-query but integrates well into investigation pipelines.
description_zh_tw: 美國來電顯示姓名（CNAM）查詢 API，查詢美國 CNAM 權威資料庫以返回與美國電話號碼關聯的已登記姓名，適用於美國情境下的來電身份驗證。
use_cases: Look up the registered CNAM name for a US phone number
Verify whether a US caller's name matches their claimed identity
Enrich US phone number leads with official CNAM registration data
curation_reason: Authoritative US CNAM data; no comparable free-tier alternative.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢美國電話號碼的註冊 CNAM 姓名
驗證美國來電者的姓名是否與其聲稱的身份相符
以官方 CNAM 註冊數據富集美國電話號碼線索

name: CallerIDTest
raw_description: Free phone number lookup and caller ID verification tool.
description_en: Free web-based phone number lookup service providing carrier, line type, and basic geographic information for US and international numbers. No account required. Useful as a fast, no-cost preliminary check before using paid APIs for enrichment.
description_zh_tw: 免費的網頁電話號碼查詢服務，提供美國和國際號碼的運營商、線路類型及基本地理信息，無需帳號，適合在使用付費 API 前進行快速的初步查詢。
use_cases: Quickly check carrier and type for a phone number without API setup
Perform a no-cost first-pass phone number triage during investigation
Verify basic phone number validity before deeper enrichment
curation_reason: Free no-account phone lookup; useful as a frictionless triage entry point.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在不設定 API 的情況下，快速檢查電話號碼的電信業者與類型
在調查期間進行無成本的第一階段電話號碼評估分流
在進行更深度的數據富集前驗證基本電話號碼的有效性

name: SunCalc
raw_description: Sun position calculator for geolocating images by shadow angle.
description_en: Interactive map-based sun position calculator that shows sun azimuth and elevation angle for any location and time of day. Investigators use it to geolocate images by matching shadow angles and directions in photographs against SunCalc predictions, narrowing possible capture locations and times.
description_zh_tw: 互動式地圖太陽位置計算器，顯示任意地點和時刻的太陽方位角和仰角。調查人員使用它通過匹配照片中的陰影角度和方向與 SunCalc 預測，縮小拍攝地點和時間範圍。
use_cases: Narrow down an image capture location by matching shadow angles to sun position predictions
Verify whether a photo's claimed timestamp is consistent with shadows and lighting
Support geolocation analysis by eliminating locations where sun angle is inconsistent
curation_reason: Unique shadow-analysis technique; core tool in Bellingcat geolocation methodology.
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過比對陰影角度與太陽位置預測，縮小影像拍攝位置的範圍
驗證相片聲稱的時間戳記是否與陰影及光線一致
透過排除太陽角度不一致的位置，來支持地理定位分析

name: Mapillary
