raw_description: Crowdsourced street-level imagery platform.
description_en: Crowdsourced street-level imagery platform (owned by Meta) with billions of geotagged photos from around the world. Useful for geolocating images against street-level views in areas not covered by Google Street View, identifying landmarks, signage, vegetation, and infrastructure in location verification workflows.
description_zh_tw: Meta 旗下的眾包街景影像平台，擁有來自全球各地數十億張地理標記照片，可在谷歌街景未覆蓋的地區進行圖像地理位置驗證，識別地標、標牌、植被和基礎設施。
use_cases: Cross-reference an image with street-level photos from areas not in Google Street View
Verify location details by matching architectural and signage details in geotagged photos
Access historical street-level imagery to track changes in a specific location
curation_reason: Fills Street View gap for geolocation; essential for remote area verification.
use_cases_zh_tw: 將圖片與非 Google 街景服務區域的街景相片進行交叉比對
透過比對附有地理標記相片中的建築與標誌細節，驗證位置詳情
存取歷史街景影像以追蹤特定位置的變更

name: Sentinel Hub
raw_description: Satellite imagery processing platform from ESA Sentinel constellation.
description_en: Cloud platform for accessing and processing European Space Agency Sentinel satellite imagery — including optical, SAR, and multispectral data. Free EO Browser allows investigators to access historical satellite imagery, monitor changes over time, and detect large-scale events like fires, floods, or infrastructure changes for geolocation and verification.
description_zh_tw: 訪問和處理歐洲航天局哨兵衛星影像的雲端平台，涵蓋光學、SAR 和多光譜數據。免費的 EO Browser 允許調查人員訪問歷史衛星影像、監測隨時間的變化及偵測大規模事件。
use_cases: Verify whether a claimed explosion, fire, or infrastructure event is visible in satellite imagery
Access historical imagery to track changes in a target location over months or years
Use SAR imagery to detect activity in areas covered by clouds or at night
curation_reason: Best free satellite imagery access for open-source verification work.
use_cases_zh_tw: 驗證衛星影像中是否可見所聲稱的爆炸、火災或基礎設施事件
存取歷史影像以追蹤目標位置在數月或數年期間的變更
使用 SAR 影像探測雲層覆蓋區域或夜間的活動

name: Overpass Turbo
raw_description: Web-based OpenStreetMap data querying tool.
description_en: Web-based query interface for extracting data from OpenStreetMap using the Overpass API query language. Allows investigators to query specific map features — shops, hospitals, towers, barriers — and export them as GeoJSON for cross-referencing with images. Useful for identifying unique infrastructure visible in verification images.
description_zh_tw: 使用 Overpass API 查詢語言從 OpenStreetMap 提取數據的網頁查詢介面，允許調查人員查詢特定地圖特徵（商店、醫院、塔台、路障等）並導出為 GeoJSON 進行交叉比對。
use_cases: Query all bus stops or mosques in a geographic area to narrow down an image location
Extract specific infrastructure types from OSM data for geolocation cross-referencing
Export geographic features as GeoJSON for integration with mapping analysis tools
curation_reason: Essential OpenStreetMap query tool for geolocation research; no substitute.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢地理區域內的所有公車站或清真寺，以縮小影像位置範圍
從 OSM 數據中提取特定基礎設施類型以進行地理定位交叉比對
匯出地理特徵為 GeoJSON，以整合至地圖分析工具中

name: Blockchain.com Explorer
raw_description: Bitcoin and Ethereum blockchain explorer by Blockchain.com.
description_en: Blockchain.com's public explorer provides free lookup of Bitcoin and Ethereum addresses, transactions, and block data with no account required. Displays address balance, transaction history, and linked addresses. A reliable first-pass tool for confirming wallet activity before moving to more specialized analytics.
description_zh_tw: Blockchain.com 的公開瀏覽器免費提供比特幣和以太坊地址、交易及區塊數據查詢，無需帳號。顯示地址餘額、交易歷史及關聯地址，是進行更深入分析前的可靠初步核查工具。
use_cases: Look up a Bitcoin address to retrieve its full transaction history and current balance
Verify whether a specific transaction hash has been confirmed on the network
Enumerate all addresses that have transacted with a wallet under investigation
curation_reason: Most recognized free BTC/ETH explorer; standard starting point for crypto OSINT.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢比特幣地址以檢索其完整交易歷史與當前餘額
驗證網路上是否已確認特定的交易雜湊值
列舉所有曾與接受調查的錢包進行交易的地址

name: Etherscan
raw_description: Ethereum blockchain explorer and analytics platform.
description_en: The primary public block explorer for the Ethereum network. Allows lookup of ETH addresses, ERC-20/ERC-721 token transfers, smart contract interactions, and gas usage. The 'Internal Txns' tab reveals contract-to-contract transfers that standard wallet displays hide. Free with optional API tier.
description_zh_tw: 以太坊網絡的主要公開區塊瀏覽器，支援 ETH 地址、ERC-20/ERC-721 代幣轉移、智能合約互動及 Gas 使用量查詢。「Internal Txns」標籤可揭示普通錢包介面隱藏的合約間轉帳。免費提供可選 API。
use_cases: Trace ERC-20 token flows through a wallet address to identify exchange deposits and withdrawals
Inspect smart contract interactions to identify what protocols a wallet has used
Use the API to batch-query multiple addresses for automated investigation workflows
curation_reason: Canonical Ethereum explorer; required for any ETH/ERC-20 investigation.
use_cases_zh_tw: 追蹤流經錢包地址的 ERC-20 代幣流，以識別交易所充值與提現
檢查智慧合約互動，以識別錢包曾使用過哪些協議
使用 API 批次查詢多個地址以進行自動化調查工作流程

name: Breadcrumbs
raw_description: Visual blockchain transaction investigation tool.
description_en: Free visual blockchain analytics platform that renders wallet transaction graphs interactively. Trace multi-hop fund flows across Bitcoin and Ethereum, annotate addresses with labels, and share investigation graphs. Designed for OSINT investigators rather than enterprise compliance, with an accessible no-install web interface.
description_zh_tw: 免費的視覺化區塊鏈分析平台，以互動圖形呈現錢包交易關係，可追蹤比特幣和以太坊的多跳資金流向、標注地址標籤並分享調查圖表，專為 OSINT 調查人員設計，無需安裝。
use_cases: Visualize fund flow from a suspicious wallet across multiple hops to identify destination exchanges
Annotate and share a blockchain investigation graph with collaborators
Identify cluster patterns in a wallet's transaction history to detect mixing or layering
curation_reason: Best free visual blockchain graph tool for non-enterprise investigators.
use_cases_zh_tw: 視覺化來自可疑錢包的多跳資金流，以識別目的地交易所
標記並與合作夥伴分享區塊鏈調查圖表
在錢包交易歷史中識別群聚模式，以偵測混幣（Mixing）或分層（Layering）行為

name: Arkham Intelligence
raw_description: On-chain entity attribution and blockchain intelligence platform.
description_en: Arkham Intelligence maps on-chain addresses to real-world entities — exchanges, funds, protocols, and individuals — using AI-assisted attribution and a community bounty system. Free public tier allows address and entity lookups with partial graph access. Notable for attributing previously pseudonymous wallets through behavioral analysis and transaction pattern matching.
description_zh_tw: Arkham Intelligence 透過 AI 輔助歸因和社群懸賞系統，將鏈上地址映射至真實世界實體（交易所、基金、協議和個人）。免費公開層允許地址和實體查詢，以行為分析和交易模式匹配歸因先前匿名的錢包。
use_cases: Look up an address to see if Arkham has attributed it to a known entity such as an exchange or fund
Trace large transfers between labeled entities to map fund movement at institutional scale
Use the portfolio view to assess the full holdings and activity of a known wallet cluster
ethics_note: Arkham de-anonymizes wallet holders by linking on-chain addresses to real-world identities, including private individuals. Use only for authorized investigative or compliance purposes.
curation_reason: Leading public-tier blockchain attribution platform; unique entity-labeling dataset.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢地址以查看 Arkham 是否已將其歸屬為已知實體（例如交易所或基金）
追蹤已標記實體之間的大額轉帳，以繪製機構規模的資金流動圖
使用投資組合視角評估已知錢包群組的完整持倉與活動

name: Bubblemaps
raw_description: Token holder cluster visualization for blockchain tokens.
description_en: Bubblemaps visualizes token holder distribution as interactive bubble charts, revealing wallet clusters, insider allocations, and coordinated holding patterns for DeFi tokens. Useful for identifying undisclosed concentrated ownership, team wallet clusters, and wash-trading patterns that are not obvious from raw on-chain data.
description_zh_tw: Bubblemaps 以互動氣泡圖呈現代幣持有者分佈，揭示 DeFi 代幣中的錢包叢集、內部人配額和協調持倉模式，適用於識別未披露的集中持倉、團隊錢包叢集和原始鏈上數據中不易察覺的洗盤模式。
use_cases: Visualize token holder clusters for a DeFi project to detect undisclosed insider wallets
Identify coordinated selling patterns across multiple wallets in a token's holder distribution
Compare holder cluster changes over time to track token distribution manipulation
curation_reason: Unique token holder visualization with no direct equivalent for DeFi cluster analysis.
use_cases_zh_tw: 視覺化 DeFi 專案的代幣持有者群組，以偵測未揭露的內部人錢包
在代幣持有者分佈中識別跨多個錢包的協同拋售模式
比較持有者群組隨時間的變化，以追蹤代幣分配操控行為

name: Blockchair
raw_description: Multi-blockchain explorer and analytics engine.
description_en: Blockchair is a privacy-focused multi-blockchain explorer supporting Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Cardano, Solana, and 15+ other chains in a single interface. Offers full-text transaction memo search, address clustering, UTXO analysis, and bulk CSV export. Notably does not sell user search data to analytics firms.
description_zh_tw: Blockchair 是注重隱私的多鏈瀏覽器，在單一介面支援比特幣、以太坊、萊特幣、Cardano、Solana 等 15+ 個鏈，提供全文交易備忘錄搜尋、地址叢集、UTXO 分析和批量 CSV 導出，且不向分析公司出售用戶搜尋數據。
use_cases: Search transaction memos across multiple chains to find references to known identifiers
Export address transaction history as CSV for offline analysis or evidence packaging
Cross-chain investigation: track funds from Bitcoin through Ethereum to identify bridge usage
curation_reason: Best multi-chain explorer; memo search and CSV export are unique differentiators.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在多個區塊鏈上搜尋交易備忘錄，以尋找對已知識別碼的引用
將地址交易歷史匯出為 CSV，以進行離線分析或證據打包
跨鏈調查：追蹤從比特幣到乙太坊的資金以識別跨鏈橋的使用

name: MetaSleuth
raw_description: Blockchain investigation and fund tracking tool by BlockSec.
description_en: MetaSleuth by BlockSec is a free visual blockchain investigation platform for tracing fund flows, labeling addresses, and sharing investigation reports. Supports multi-chain analysis including Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, and others. Notable for detecting bridge-crossing transactions that move funds between chains to obscure trails.
description_zh_tw: BlockSec 開發的 MetaSleuth 是免費的視覺化區塊鏈調查平台，用於追蹤資金流向、標記地址和分享調查報告，支援以太坊、BNB Chain、Polygon 等多鏈分析，尤其擅長偵測跨鏈橋交易以追蹤跨鏈資金轉移痕跡。
use_cases: Trace multi-chain fund movements to follow assets transferred across bridge protocols
Generate a shareable investigation report linking wallet addresses to identified entities
Label custom addresses within an investigation graph and export for evidence documentation
curation_reason: Best free multi-chain bridge-crossing tracker; strong DeFi incident investigation tool.
use_cases_zh_tw: 追蹤跨鏈資金流動，以跟隨跨越跨鏈橋協議轉移的資產
生成可分享的調查報告，將錢包地址連結至已識別的實體
在調查圖表中標記自訂地址並匯出以進行證據存檔

name: OXT
raw_description: Bitcoin transaction graph analysis and privacy research tool.
description_en: OXT is a free Bitcoin-specific blockchain explorer focused on transaction graph analysis and clustering heuristics. Implements UTXO-based address clustering, coin tracing, and privacy analysis techniques used by researchers. Particularly useful for studying Bitcoin privacy properties and tracing coinjoins or mixer outputs.
description_zh_tw: OXT 是免費的比特幣專用區塊鏈瀏覽器，專注於交易圖分析和聚類啟發式算法，實現基於 UTXO 的地址叢集化、代幣追蹤和研究人員使用的隱私分析技術，尤其適合研究比特幣隱私特性及追蹤 CoinJoin 或混幣輸出。
use_cases: Cluster Bitcoin addresses using common-input-ownership heuristics to identify wallet boundaries
Analyze coinjoin transactions to assess whether effective privacy was achieved
Study the UTXO graph structure of a Bitcoin address to identify change outputs
curation_reason: Best free Bitcoin UTXO clustering tool; unique heuristic capabilities.
use_cases_zh_tw: 使用共同輸入所有權啟發式方法群聚比特幣地址，以識別錢包邊界
分析 CoinJoin 交易以評估是否實現了有效的隱私保護
研究比特幣地址的 UTXO 圖結構以識別找零輸出（Change outputs）

name: Dune Analytics
raw_description: Community-driven blockchain analytics platform with SQL queries.
description_en: Dune Analytics allows anyone to query blockchain data using SQL, with a vast library of community-published dashboards covering DeFi protocols, NFT markets, and wallet activity. Free tier enables query execution and dashboard access. Useful for investigators who need custom on-chain queries that go beyond what standard explorers provide.
description_zh_tw: Dune Analytics 允許任何人使用 SQL 查詢區塊鏈數據，擁有涵蓋 DeFi 協議、NFT 市場和錢包活動的大量社群發布儀表板。免費層支援查詢執行和儀表板訪問，適合需要超越標準瀏覽器能力的自定義鏈上查詢的調查人員。
use_cases: Run custom SQL queries to identify all wallets that interacted with a specific smart contract
Access community dashboards tracking known exploit addresses or hacker wallet patterns
Analyze protocol-level fund flows to map money movement through DeFi applications
curation_reason: Only free SQL blockchain query platform; irreplaceable for custom on-chain analysis.
use_cases_zh_tw: 執行自訂 SQL 查詢以識別所有與特定智慧合約互動的錢包
存取追蹤已知漏洞利用地址或駭客錢包模式的社群儀表板
分析協議級別的資金流，以映射流經 DeFi 應用程式的資金流動

name: Crystal Intelligence
raw_description: Blockchain analytics and compliance intelligence platform.
description_en: Crystal Intelligence provides blockchain transaction monitoring, risk scoring, and entity attribution across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and 100+ assets. Free account offers limited lookups and risk score checks. Primarily used by compliance teams but accessible enough for investigators who need to check an address's risk profile against known hacking, darknet, and ransomware entities.
description_zh_tw: Crystal Intelligence 提供比特幣、以太坊及 100+ 種資產的區塊鏈交易監控、風險評分和實體歸因。免費帳號提供有限查詢和風險評分核查，主要用於合規團隊，也適合需要對照已知駭客、暗網和勒索軟體實體核查地址風險檔案的調查人員。
use_cases: Check whether a wallet address has exposure to known darknet markets or sanctioned entities
Obtain a risk score for a Bitcoin address before accepting a payment
Identify the source of funds for a wallet through automated risk categorization
curation_reason: Accessible freemium risk-scoring alternative to Chainalysis for non-enterprise use.
use_cases_zh_tw: 檢查錢包地址是否曾暴露於已知的暗網市場或受制裁實體中
在接受付款前獲取比特幣地址的風險評估分數
透過自動化風險分類識別錢包的資金來源

name: Chainalysis Reactor
raw_description: Enterprise blockchain investigation and transaction tracing platform.
description_en: Chainalysis Reactor is the industry-standard enterprise blockchain investigation platform, used by law enforcement agencies, regulators, and financial institutions across 70+ countries. Traces fund flows, de-anonymizes wallets through proprietary clustering, and links on-chain activity to off-chain identities from exchange KYC data. Paid enterprise licensing required; included here as a reference standard.
description_zh_tw: Chainalysis Reactor 是被 70+ 國執法機構、監管機構和金融機構使用的行業標準企業級區塊鏈調查平台，追蹤資金流動、通過專有叢集化去匿名化錢包，並將鏈上活動與交易所 KYC 數據中的真實身份關聯。需企業授權，此處收錄作為行業參考標準。
use_cases: Conduct court-admissible blockchain tracing with full audit trail for law enforcement use
Access proprietary exchange attribution data to identify where illicit funds were cashed out
Generate regulatory compliance reports linking transaction clusters to real-world entities
ethics_note: Uses proprietary KYC data from exchange partners to de-anonymize wallet holders; access implies legal authority or enterprise compliance use case.
curation_reason: Industry-standard law enforcement blockchain tool; important reference even at enterprise tier.
use_cases_zh_tw: 進行符合法庭證據標準的區塊鏈追蹤，並為執法用途提供完整審計軌跡
存取專有的交易所歸屬數據，以識別非法資金在何處提現
生成將交易群組連結至現實世界實體的法規合規報告

name: Hyperbot
raw_description: AI-powered on-chain intelligence for Hyperliquid perpetual DEX.
description_en: Hyperbot is an AI-powered on-chain intelligence platform focused on Hyperliquid and Aster perpetual DEXs. It provides whale tracking, smart money identification, and PnL curve analysis across 600,000+ Hyperliquid addresses using natural language queries and AI tagging. Useful for investigators tracing large-position holders, attributing wallet clusters, and monitoring coordinated trading behavior on decentralized perpetual exchanges.
description_zh_tw: Hyperbot 是以 AI 驅動的鏈上情報平台，專注於 Hyperliquid 與 Aster 永續 DEX，透過自然語言查詢與 AI 標籤追蹤逾 60 萬個 Hyperliquid 地址的巨鯨動向、聰明錢識別與損益曲線分析，適用於追蹤大倉位持有者、歸因錢包叢集及監控協調交易行為。
use_cases: Identify top PnL wallets on Hyperliquid to attribute coordinated market activity to known entities
Monitor whale address movements and alert patterns for on-chain behavioral profiling
Cross-reference large trader addresses across DEX leaderboards to build a trader identity graph
ethics_note: Wallet attribution and behavioral profiling of traders may expose pseudonymous individuals; use only for legitimate investigative or compliance purposes.
curation_reason: Unique AI-powered DEX trader profiling tool with no mainstream equivalent.
use_cases_zh_tw: 識別 Hyperliquid 上收益最高（PnL）的錢包，將協同的市場活動歸因於已知實體
監控巨鯨地址動向和警報模式以進行鏈上行為分析
交叉比對 DEX 排行榜上的大額交易者地址，以建立交易者身分圖譜

name: Flightradar24
raw_description: Real-time ADS-B aircraft tracking platform.
description_en: Flightradar24 aggregates ADS-B, MLAT, and FAA data to display real-time and historical positions for 180,000+ flights per day worldwide. Free tier shows current positions and basic flight data. Investigators use it to verify aircraft movements, track tail numbers, identify routes for a specific aircraft, and cross-reference with ground events.
description_zh_tw: Flightradar24 聚合 ADS-B、MLAT 和 FAA 數據，每日即時顯示全球逾 18 萬架次航班的位置。免費層提供當前位置和基本航班數據，調查人員可用它核實飛機動向、追蹤尾號、識別特定飛機的航線並與地面事件交叉比對。
use_cases: Track the real-time position and route of an aircraft by registration or flight number
Review historical flight paths for a specific tail number to establish movement patterns
Verify whether a private aircraft was present at a specific location during an event
curation_reason: Widest global ADS-B coverage; standard tool for aircraft OSINT.
use_cases_zh_tw: 按註冊號或航班號追蹤飛機的即時位置與航線
審查特定機尾號的歷史飛行路徑以建立活動模式
驗證在特定事件期間私人飛機是否曾出現在該地點

name: ADS-B Exchange
raw_description: Unfiltered community ADS-B flight tracking without government request compliance.
description_en: ADS-B Exchange is a community-run ADS-B aggregator that does not comply with government or corporate requests to remove or block aircraft from its feed — unlike Flightradar24. This makes it the preferred source for tracking military, law enforcement, and government aircraft that commercial platforms occasionally suppress. Free data access via web and API.
description_zh_tw: ADS-B Exchange 是社群運營的 ADS-B 聚合器，不遵從政府或企業的移除/屏蔽飛機請求，有別於 Flightradar24，是追蹤偶爾被商業平台壓制的軍用、執法和政府飛機的首選來源，免費提供網頁和 API 數據訪問。
use_cases: Track military or government aircraft that are hidden or suppressed on commercial ADS-B platforms
Access unfiltered flight data via API for automated aircraft monitoring workflows
Verify historical aircraft positions when a commercial platform has removed the track
curation_reason: Only unfiltered ADS-B source; critical for government/military aircraft OSINT.
use_cases_zh_tw: 追蹤在商業 ADS-B 平台上被隱藏或壓制的軍用或政府飛機
透過 API 存取未經過濾的飛行數據，以進行自動化飛機監控工作流程
當商業平台移除軌跡時，驗證歷史飛機位置

name: MarineTraffic
raw_description: AIS vessel tracking and maritime intelligence platform.
description_en: MarineTraffic is the leading public AIS vessel tracking platform, displaying real-time and historical positions for ships worldwide using Automatic Identification System (AIS) radio broadcasts. Free tier provides current vessel positions and basic voyage data. Used by investigators to track ship movements, verify port calls, and identify flag-of-convenience vessels.
description_zh_tw: MarineTraffic 是領先的公開 AIS 船舶追蹤平台，利用自動識別系統（AIS）無線電廣播顯示全球船舶的即時和歷史位置。免費層提供當前船舶位置和基本航次數據，用於追蹤船舶動向、核實靠港情況和識別方便旗船舶。
use_cases: Track a vessel's current position and review its historical voyage route and port calls
Identify all vessels registered under a specific flag state or operating company
Verify whether a ship was in a specific location during a reported maritime incident
curation_reason: Primary public AIS vessel tracker; essential for maritime investigation.
use_cases_zh_tw: 追蹤船隻的當前位置，並審查其歷史航線與港口停靠記錄
識別在特定船旗國或營運公司下註冊的所有船隻
驗證在通報的海事事故期間，船隻是否位於特定位置

name: OpenSky Network
raw_description: Open academic ADS-B network providing historical flight data.
description_en: OpenSky Network is a non-profit ADS-B aggregation network operated by academic institutions, offering free historical flight data download for research purposes. Unlike commercial platforms, it provides access to raw ADS-B records for specific time windows and geographic regions. Valuable when you need historical aircraft data that commercial platforms restrict behind paywalls.
description_zh_tw: OpenSky Network 是由學術機構運營的非營利 ADS-B 聚合網絡，免費提供用於研究目的的歷史飛行數據下載，提供特定時間窗口和地理區域的原始 ADS-B 記錄，在商業平台將歷史數據鎖在付費牆後尤為有價值。
use_cases: Download historical ADS-B records for a geographic region during a specific time window
Access raw flight data for investigative analysis without commercial platform restrictions
Cross-reference aircraft tracks from different data sources to verify position accuracy
curation_reason: Only free source of raw historical ADS-B data for research use.
use_cases_zh_tw: 下載特定時間窗口內某一地理區域的歷史 ADS-B 記錄
獲取用於調查分析的原始飛行數據，而不受商業平台限制
交叉比對來自不同數據源的飛機軌跡以驗證位置準確性

name: WebSDR
raw_description: Network of web-accessible software-defined radio receivers.
description_en: WebSDR hosts a network of publicly accessible Software Defined Radio (SDR) receivers connected to the internet, allowing anyone to tune and listen to radio frequencies worldwide through a web browser without any hardware. Useful for monitoring public shortwave broadcasts, amateur radio activity, and HF signals from specific geographic regions.
description_zh_tw: WebSDR 托管一個可通過網絡訪問的軟件定義無線電（SDR）接收器網絡，允許任何人在不需要任何硬件的情況下通過網絡瀏覽器調諧和收聽全球無線電頻率，適用於監聽特定地理區域的公共短波廣播、業餘無線電活動和 HF 信號。
use_cases: Listen to public shortwave broadcasts or amateur radio from a specific geographic region
Monitor HF frequencies used for known public emergency or maritime communications
Verify whether a specific frequency is being used in a target area without local hardware
curation_reason: Unique zero-hardware SDR access; only public listening network of its kind.
use_cases_zh_tw: 收聽來自特定地理區域的公開短波廣播或業餘無線電
監控用於已知公共緊急或海事通訊的高頻（HF）頻率
在沒有本地硬體的情況下，驗證特定頻率是否正在目標區域中使用

name: Signal Identification Wiki
raw_description: Community wiki for identifying unknown radio signals.
description_en: Signal Identification Wiki is a community-maintained reference database of radio signal types with audio samples, waterfall images, and technical parameters. Used by investigators and radio operators to identify an unknown signal's origin, modulation, and likely purpose. Covers military, commercial, maritime, and amateur signal types.
description_zh_tw: Signal Identification Wiki 是社群維護的無線電信號類型參考資料庫，包含音頻樣本、瀑布圖和技術參數，供調查人員和無線電操作員識別未知信號的來源、調制方式和可能用途，涵蓋軍用、商用、海事和業餘信號類型。
use_cases: Identify an unknown radio signal by comparing its waterfall pattern to the signal database
Determine the modulation type and likely use case of a signal recorded during monitoring
Research which agencies or services typically use a specific frequency band and signal type
curation_reason: Definitive reference for radio signal identification; no comparable free alternative.
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過比對其瀑布圖模式與信號資料庫，識別未知的無線電信號
確定監控期間記錄的信號調變類型與可能的使用情境
研究哪些機構或服務通常使用特定的頻段和信號類型

name: RadioReference
raw_description: Comprehensive radio frequency and trunked system database.
description_en: RadioReference is the world's largest radio frequency database, covering police, fire, EMS, federal, and military trunked radio systems across the US and internationally. Free tier provides frequency lookups by location, agency, or system. Used by investigators to identify what public-safety agencies are operating in a specific area and what frequencies they use.
description_zh_tw: RadioReference 是全球最大的無線電頻率資料庫，涵蓋美國及國際的警察、消防、急救、聯邦和軍用集群無線電系統。免費層提供按地點、機構或系統的頻率查詢，供調查人員識別特定區域的公共安全機構及其使用頻率。
use_cases: Look up all public-safety radio frequencies operating in a specific city or county
Identify the trunked radio system used by a law enforcement agency for monitoring authorization
Research federal agency radio systems operating in a target geographic area
curation_reason: World's most comprehensive public radio frequency database; no direct equivalent.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢在特定城市或郡運作的所有公共安全無線電頻率
識別執法機構使用的集群無線電系統以進行監控授權
研究在目標地理區域內運作的聯邦機構無線電系統

name: LiveATC
raw_description: Live and archived air traffic control audio feeds worldwide.
description_en: LiveATC streams live and archived Air Traffic Control (ATC) radio communications from airports worldwide, contributed by volunteer feeders. Coverage spans 2,000+ airports across 150+ countries. Investigators and journalists use it to verify reported aircraft incidents, listen to communications during known events, and access archived feeds for specific dates.
description_zh_tw: LiveATC 從全球 150+ 國家、2,000+ 機場直播和存檔空中交通管制（ATC）無線電通訊，由志願者供稿。調查人員和記者使用它核實報告的飛機事故、監聽已知事件中的通訊，並訪問特定日期的存檔供料。
use_cases: Listen to ATC communications at a specific airport during a reported aviation incident
Access archived ATC audio to verify what was communicated during a specific event
Monitor active airport frequencies to track unusual aircraft activity in real time
curation_reason: Unique archive of ATC communications; essential for aviation incident research.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在通報的航空事故期間，收聽特定機場的航管（ATC）通訊
存取封存的航管音訊，以驗證在特定事件期間溝通了哪些內容
監控活躍的機場頻率，以即時追蹤異常的飛機活動

name: VesselFinder
raw_description: AIS vessel tracking platform with historical voyage data.
description_en: VesselFinder is an AIS maritime tracking platform providing real-time ship positions, vessel particulars, and voyage history. Useful as a cross-reference source alongside MarineTraffic, as different platforms receive AIS from different ground station networks and may show vessels the other misses. Free tier covers current positions and basic vessel data.
description_zh_tw: VesselFinder 是提供即時船舶位置、船舶詳情和航次歷史的 AIS 海事追蹤平台，可與 MarineTraffic 交叉比對，因不同平台從不同地面站網絡接收 AIS，可能顯示對方遺漏的船舶。免費層涵蓋當前位置和基本船舶數據。
use_cases: Cross-reference a vessel's position with MarineTraffic to verify AIS reporting consistency
Look up vessel registration details, IMO number, and flag state for a ship under investigation
Track port arrivals and departures to build a vessel's recent activity timeline
curation_reason: Complementary AIS coverage to MarineTraffic; different ground station network.
use_cases_zh_tw: 將船隻位置與 MarineTraffic 進行交叉比對，以驗證 AIS 通報的一致性
查詢接受調查的船隻之船舶註冊詳情、IMO 編號和船旗國
追蹤港口抵達與出發情況，以建立船隻近期的活動時間軸

name: Airframes
raw_description: ACARS and VDL aircraft data link message decoder and archive.
description_en: Airframes decodes and archives ACARS (Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System) and VDL Mode 2 data link messages broadcast by commercial aircraft. These messages contain flight plan updates, weather reports, maintenance notifications, and position reports. Provides operational intelligence beyond ADS-B, including engine performance data and pre-departure clearances.
description_zh_tw: Airframes 解碼並存檔商業飛機廣播的 ACARS 和 VDL Mode 2 數據鏈信息，包含飛行計劃更新、天氣報告、維護通知和位置報告，提供超越 ADS-B 的運營情報，包括發動機性能數據和起飛前許可。
use_cases: Access ACARS message history for a specific tail number to review operational communications
Decode pre-departure clearance messages to see filed flight plans before departure
Monitor maintenance and fault messages for aircraft to identify operational anomalies
curation_reason: Unique ACARS archive; only public source of decoded aircraft data link messages.
use_cases_zh_tw: 存取特定機尾號的 ACARS 訊息歷史以審查運作通訊
解碼起飛前許可訊息以在起飛前查看已申報的飛行計劃
監控飛機的維護和故障訊息以識別運作異常

name: ZoomEye
raw_description: Chinese cyberspace search engine for internet-connected devices.
description_en: ZoomEye by Knownsec is a Chinese-developed cyberspace search engine that indexes internet-facing devices and services, including industrial control systems, webcams, and network appliances. Particularly effective for discovering devices in Asia-Pacific regions that Shodan and Censys may undercount. Free tier allows limited queries. Supports Dork-style search syntax.
description_zh_tw: 知道創宇開發的 ZoomEye 是中國自主研發的網絡空間搜尋引擎，索引網絡連接設備和服務，包括工業控制系統、攝影機和網絡設備，尤其擅長發現 Shodan 和 Censys 可能低估的亞太地區設備。免費層允許有限查詢，支援 Dork 式搜尋語法。
use_cases: Search for exposed devices in a specific Asia-Pacific IP range not well-covered by Shodan
Use ZoomEye Dork syntax to find a specific device type or firmware version globally
Cross-reference a device fingerprint with ZoomEye to verify geographic distribution
ethics_note: Use for passive enumeration and exposure assessment only. Do not use results to access, exploit, or interact with discovered devices without explicit authorization.
curation_reason: Best Shodan alternative for Asia-Pacific IoT coverage; distinct dataset.
use_cases_zh_tw: 在 Shodan 未能良好覆蓋的特定亞太地區 IP 範圍內搜尋暴露的裝置
使用 ZoomEye Dork 語法在全球範圍內尋找特定的裝置類型或韌體版本
將裝置指紋與 ZoomEye 進行交叉比對以驗證地理分佈

name: FOFA
raw_description: Chinese cyberspace asset mapping and threat intelligence platform.
description_en: FOFA is a cyberspace mapping and intelligence platform developed by Baimaohui Security Research Center. It indexes internet-facing services with detailed fingerprinting, supporting searches by domain, IP, certificate, banner, and product keyword. Often surfaces devices and services in China and Southeast Asia not found in Western-operated scanners.
description_zh_tw: FOFA 是白帽匯安全研究中心開發的網絡空間測繪和情報平台，對網絡連接服務進行詳細指紋識別，支援按域名、IP、憑證、橫幅和產品關鍵字搜尋，常發現西方掃描器未收錄的中國和東南亞設備和服務。
use_cases: Search for exposed services in China or Southeast Asia using certificate or banner fingerprints
Identify the geographic spread of a specific IoT device model across different countries
Find internet-exposed instances of specific industrial software or control panel versions
ethics_note: Passive enumeration only. Do not attempt to access or exploit any discovered services without explicit written authorization.
curation_reason: Superior coverage for Asian networks; complements Shodan for global IoT mapping.
use_cases_zh_tw: 利用憑證或橫幅（Banner）指紋搜尋中國或東南亞暴露的服務
識別特定 IoT 裝置型號在不同國家的地理分佈情況
尋找特定工業軟體或控制面板版本暴露於網際網路的實例

name: BinaryEdge
raw_description: Internet-wide scan platform for attack surface and IoT exposure monitoring.
description_en: BinaryEdge continuously scans the internet to map attack surfaces, identify exposed IoT devices, and detect misconfigured services. Provides structured data on open ports, protocols, certificates, and service banners. Free tier offers limited queries. Its Tormentor scoring system highlights the most critical exposures for triage prioritization.
description_zh_tw: BinaryEdge 持續掃描互聯網以繪製攻擊面、識別暴露的 IoT 設備和偵測錯誤配置的服務，提供關於開放端口、協議、憑證和服務橫幅的結構化數據。免費層提供有限查詢，其 Tormentor 評分系統突出顯示最關鍵的暴露以供分類優先處理。
use_cases: Identify all internet-exposed services for a target organization's IP range
Detect misconfigured databases, storage buckets, or management interfaces in an IP block
Monitor attack surface changes over time for a specific domain or organization
ethics_note: Attack surface data should be used defensively to assess your own infrastructure, or in authorized security assessments. Do not use to target or interact with third-party systems.
curation_reason: Structured IoT exposure data with risk scoring; distinct from Shodan in methodology.
use_cases_zh_tw: 識別目標組織 IP 範圍內所有暴露於網際網路的服務
在 IP 區段中偵測配置錯誤的資料庫、儲存桶或管理介面
監控特定網域或組織的攻擊面隨時間的變更

name: Onyphe
raw_description: French cyber defense search engine for internet-facing infrastructure.
description_en: Onyphe is a European cyber threat intelligence search engine that collects data from internet scans, honeypots, dark web crawls, and threat feeds. Unlike Shodan, it combines passive DNS, WHOIS, and threat intelligence data in a single query interface. Free tier available. Used for holistic assessment of an IP or domain across multiple data sources simultaneously.
description_zh_tw: Onyphe 是歐洲網絡威脅情報搜尋引擎，從互聯網掃描、蜜罐、暗網爬取和威脅供料收集數據，與 Shodan 不同，它在單一查詢介面中結合被動 DNS、WHOIS 和威脅情報數據。提供免費層，用於跨多個數據源同時全面評估 IP 或域名。
use_cases: Query an IP address to see its combined scan data, threat intelligence, and passive DNS records
Find internet-exposed services that have appeared in honeypot logs or threat feeds
Assess an organization's attack surface with a multi-source view not available in single-source scanners
curation_reason: European multi-source intelligence aggregator; unique dark web + scan data combination.
use_cases_zh_tw: 查詢 IP 地址以查看其合併的掃描數據、威脅情報與被動 DNS 記錄
尋找曾出現在蜜罐（Honeypot）日誌或威脅來源中的網際網路暴露服務
利用單一來源掃描器無法提供的多源檢視評估組織的攻擊面

name: LeakIX
raw_description: Internet scanner focused on exposed and misconfigured services.
description_en: LeakIX specializes in identifying publicly exposed services that are misconfigured or leaking data — including open MongoDB databases, exposed Elasticsearch clusters, unprotected S3-compatible storage, and insecure IoT management interfaces. Data is collected passively and displayed with severity classifications. Free for researchers and security professionals.
description_zh_tw: LeakIX 專注於識別配置錯誤或洩露數據的公開暴露服務，包括開放的 MongoDB 資料庫、暴露的 Elasticsearch 集群、未受保護的 S3 兼容存儲和不安全的 IoT 管理介面，被動收集數據並按嚴重性分類顯示，供研究人員和安全專業人員免費使用。
use_cases: Search for exposed databases or storage buckets associated with a target domain or IP range
Identify publicly visible IoT management consoles or admin panels in a target organization's infrastructure
Check whether a specific technology stack has known misconfiguration patterns visible at an IP
ethics_note: Data reflects real misconfigured production systems. Use only for assessing your own infrastructure or reporting to asset owners. Do not access or extract data from discovered exposed services.
curation_reason: Unique focus on misconfiguration-based exposure; data not available from generic scanners.
use_cases_zh_tw: 搜尋與目標網域或 IP 範圍關聯的暴露資料庫或儲存桶
在目標組織的基礎設施中識別公開可見的 IoT 管理主控台或管理面板
檢查特定的技術棧在某個 IP 上是否有可見的已知配置錯誤模式

name: Criminal IP
raw_description: Attack surface intelligence engine with AI-powered threat scoring.
description_en: Criminal IP is a cyber threat intelligence search engine that continuously scans the internet and assigns AI-driven risk scores to IP addresses, domains, and exposed services. Features domain and certificate search, port scan history, and a vulnerability mapping layer. Free tier available. Particularly strong for identifying high-risk IoT and OT device exposures.
description_zh_tw: Criminal IP 是持續掃描互聯網並對 IP 地址、域名和暴露服務賦予 AI 驅動風險評分的網絡威脅情報搜尋引擎，具有域名和憑證搜尋、端口掃描歷史和漏洞映射層，免費層可用，尤其擅長識別高風險 IoT 和 OT 設備暴露。
use_cases: Obtain an AI risk score for an IP address to quickly triage its threat level
Search for exposed IoT device types by banner or certificate fingerprint with risk scoring
Review port scan history for an IP to identify recently opened or closed services
curation_reason: Emerging alternative to Shodan with AI risk scoring; strong IoT threat detection.
use_cases_zh_tw: 獲取 IP 地址的 AI 風險評估分數，以快速分流其威脅級別
透過橫幅或憑證指紋搜尋暴露的 IoT 裝置類型並進行風險評分
審查 IP 的通訊埠掃描歷史以識別近期開啟或關閉的服務

name: FullHunt
raw_description: Attack surface discovery and monitoring platform.
description_en: FullHunt maps an organization's entire internet-exposed attack surface — domains, subdomains, IP ranges, and associated open ports and services — from a single domain or company name query. Free tier covers basic asset discovery. Useful for building a complete picture of an organization's IoT and web-facing infrastructure exposure before investigation.
description_zh_tw: FullHunt 從單個域名或公司名稱查詢映射組織的整個互聯網暴露攻擊面，包括域名、子域名、IP 範圍及關聯的開放端口和服務。免費層涵蓋基本資產發現，適用於在調查前建立組織 IoT 和面向網絡的基礎設施暴露的完整圖景。
use_cases: Enumerate all internet-exposed assets for a target organization from a single domain query
Identify subdomains and associated infrastructure that a company may not be aware of
Monitor attack surface changes for an organization over time to detect new exposures
curation_reason: Simplest full attack surface view for an organization; no equivalent free tool.
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過單一網域查詢，列舉目標組織的所有網際網路暴露資產
識別公司可能未察覺的子網域與關聯基礎設施
監控組織的攻擊面變化，以偵測新的安全暴露

name: PublicWWW
raw_description: Source code and digital fingerprint search engine for websites.
description_en: PublicWWW indexes the source code of billions of websites, allowing search by HTML snippet, JavaScript library, meta tag, tracking ID, or technology fingerprint. Useful for finding IoT device web management interfaces that expose version strings or default page titles, identifying all websites using a specific technology, or tracking malicious code distribution.
description_zh_tw: PublicWWW 索引數十億個網站的源代碼，允許按 HTML 片段、JavaScript 庫、meta 標籤、追蹤 ID 或技術指紋搜尋，可用於查找暴露版本字符串或默認頁面標題的 IoT 設備網絡管理界面、識別使用特定技術的所有網站或追蹤惡意代碼分佈。
use_cases: Search for all websites exposing a specific IoT device admin panel by its default page title
Find all sites using a specific JavaScript tracking ID to map an entity's web infrastructure
Identify websites sharing a specific code snippet to detect malicious injection campaigns
curation_reason: Unique source-code fingerprint search with no direct equivalent; strong IoT panel detection.
use_cases_zh_tw: 透過預設網頁標題，搜尋所有暴露特定 IoT 裝置管理面板的網站
尋找使用特定 JavaScript 追蹤 ID 的所有網站，以映射實體的網站基礎設施
識別共享特定程式碼片段的網站，以偵測惡意植入活動
